a: Degorem beracha leatzmo.
Rav huna achal telesar rifte bene telata telata bekabba vela barech. amar leh rav nachman: ade kafna! ella kol sheacherim kovim alav seuda, tzarich levarech.

Rav yehuda hava asek leh livreh be rav yehuda bar chaviva. ayyto lekammayyhu pat habbaa bechisanin. ki ata, shaminhu deka mevarchi "hammotzi". amar lehu: may "tzitzi" deka shamana? dilma "hammotzi lechem min haaretz" ka mevarchitu? amri leh: in. detanya, rabbi muna amar mishshum rabbi yehuda: pat habbaa bechisanin mevarchin aleha "hammotzi", veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi muna.

Amar lehu: en halacha kerabbi muna ittemar. amri leh: veha mar hu deamar mishshemeh dishmuel lachmaniyyot mearvin bahen, umevarchin alehen "hammotzi"? shane hatam dekava seodteh alayyhu, aval hecha dela kava seodteh alayyhu — la.

Rav pappa ikkela leve rav huna bereh derav natan. batar degamri seodtayyhu ayyto lekammayyhu midde lemechal shakel rav pappa veka achel. amri leh: la savar la mar gamar asur milleechol? amar lehu: "sillek" ittemar.

Rava verabbi zera ikkelau leve resh galuta. levatar desalliku takka mikkammayyhu shaddaru lehu ristana mibbe resh galuta. rava achel verabbi zera la achel. amar leh: la savar la mar sillek asur milleechol? amar leh: anan attakka deresh galuta samchinan.

Amar rav: haragil beshemen — shemen meakkevo. amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, amar lan: kegon anan dirgilinan bemishcha — mishcha meakkeva lan. velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha deamar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: shalosh techifot hen: techef lismicha shechita, techef ligulla tefilla, techef lintilat yadayim beracha.
Amar abbaye, af anu nomar: techef letalmide chachamim beracha. shenneemar: "vayvarcheni Adonai biglalecha". ibbaet ema mehacha, shenneemar: "vayvarech Adonai et bet hammitzri biglal yosef".

Mishna berach al hayyayin shellifne hammazon — patar et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon. berach al happarperet shellifne hammazon — patar et happarperet shelleachar hammazon. berach al happat — patar et happarperet. al happarperet — lo patar et happat. bet shammay omrim: af lo maase kedera.
Hayu yoshvin — kol echad mevarech leatzmo. hesabbu — echad mevarech lechullan.
b: Ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon — kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. achar hammazon — echad mevarech lechullam. vehu omer al hammugemar, veaf al pi sheen meviin et hammugemar ella leachar seuda.
Gemara amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim, hoil veadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin. aval bishar yemot hashshana, mevarech al kol kos vachos.

Ittemar name: amar rabba bar mari amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo shanu ella beshabbatot veyamim tovim, uveshaa sheadam yotze mibbet hammerchatz, uvishat hakkazat dam, hoil veadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin. aval bishar yemot hashshana — mevarech al kol kos vachos.
Rabba bar mari ikkela leve rava bechol. chazyeh devarech lifne hammazon, vahadar barech leachar hammazon. amar leh: yishar. vechen amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi.
Rav yitzchak bar yosef ikkela leve abbaye beyom tov. chazyeh devarech akkol kasa vechasa. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derabbi yehoshua ben levi?! amar leh: nimlach ana.

Ibbaya lehu: ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon mahu sheyyiftor et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon? im timtze lomar berach al hayyayin shellifne hammazon poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon — mishshum deze lishtot veze lishtot. aval hacha — deze lishtot, veze lishrot — la. o dilma la shena.

Rav amar: poter, verav kahana amar: eno poter. rav nachman amar: poter, verav sheshet amar: eno poter. rav huna verav yehuda vechol talmide derav amri: eno poter. etiveh rava lerav nachman: ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon — kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. leachar hammazon — echad mevarech lechullam. amar leh, hachi kaamar: im lo ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon ella leachar hammazon, echad mevarech lechullam.
Berach al happat, patar et happarperet. al happarperet, lo patar et happat. bet shammay omrim: af lo maase kedera.

Ibbaya lehu: bet shammay aresha peligi, o dilma assefa peligi? dekaamar tanna kamma berach al happat — patar et happarperet, vechol shekken maase kedera. veate bet shammay lememar la mibbaya parperet dela patra lehu pat, ella afillu maase kedera name la patra. o dilma assefa peligi, dekatane: berach al happarperet — lo patar et happat. pat hu dela patar aval maase kedera — patar. veatu bet shammay lememar vaafillu maase kedera name la patar.
Teku.

Hayu yoshvin kol echad veechad kulei. hesabbu — in, lo hesabbu — la. ureminhu: asara shehayu holchim badderech, af al pi shekkullam ochlim mikkikkar echad — kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. yashvu leechol, af al pi shekkol echad veechad ochel mikkikkaro — echad mevarech lechullam. katane "yashvu" af al pi shello hesabbu!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon deamri "nezil venechol lachma beduch pelan".

Ki nach nafsheh derav, azul talmideh batreh. ki hadri, amri: nezil venechul lachma annehar danak. batar decharchi, yatvi veka mibbaya lehu: "hesabbu" davka tenan, aval yashvu la, o dilma kevan deamri "nezil venechol rifta beducheta pelanita" — ki hesabbu dame? la hava bidayyhu.
Kam rav adda bar ahava

a: Ahdar kireh laachoreh, ukera keria acharina. amar: nach nafsheh derav, uvirkat mezona la gamrinan. ad daata hahu sava, rema lehu matnitin abbarayyta, veshanni lehu: kevan deamri "nezil venechol lachma beduch pelan" — kehesabbu dame.
Hesabbu, echad mevarech. amar rav: lo shanu ella pat devae hasibba, aval yayin la bae hasibba. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu yayin name bae hasibba.
Ikka deamri, amar rav: lo shanu ella pat — demahneya leh hasibba. aval yayin — la mahneya leh hasibba. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu yayin name mahneya leh hasibba.

Metivi: ketzad seder hasibba? — orchin nichnasin veyoshvin al gabbe safsalin veal gabbe katedraot ad sheyyikkansu kullam. heviu lahem mayim — kol echad veechad notel yado achat. ba lahem yayin — kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. alu vehesabbu uva lahem mayim, af al pi shekkol echad veechad natal yado achat, chozer venotel shete yadav. ba lahem yayin — af al pi shekkol echad veechad berach leatzmo, echad mevarech lechullam.
Lehaech lishshana deamar rav lo shanu ella pat devae hasibba, aval yayin la bae hasibba — kashya resha!
Shane orchin dedatayyhu lemikar.
Ulehaech lishshana deamar rav lo shanu ella pat, demahneya leh hasibba, aval yayin la mahneya leh hasibba — kashya sefa!
Shane hatam, demiggo deka mahneya leh hasibba lefat — mahneya leh hasibba leyayin.

Ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon. shaalu et ben zoma: mippene ma amru ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon — kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo, leachar hammazon — echad mevarech lechullam? amar lahem: hoil veen bet habbelia panuy.
Vehu omer al hammugemar kulei. middekatane "vehu omer al hammugemar", michlal deikka adif minneh, veammay!
Hoil vehu natal yadav techilla baacharona.

Mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: hannotel yadav techilla baacharona — hu mezumman labberacha. rav verabbi chiyyay havo yatvi kammeh derabbi bisodta. amar leh rabbi lerav: kum meshi yedach. chazyeh dahava merattet. amar leh rabbi chiyyay: bar pachate, ayyen bevirkat mezona kaamar lach.

Amar rabbi zera amar rava bar yirmeya: meematay mevarchin al hareach — mishshettaale timrato. amar leh rabbi zera lerava bar yirmeya: veha la arach? amar leh: uletamaych, "hammotzi lechem min haaretz" dimvarech veha la achal! ella dateh lemechal, hacha name dateh leoroche.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bereh deabba bar nachmani amar rav chisda amar rav, veamri la amar rav chisda amar zeeri: kol hammugemarot mevarchin alehen "bore atze besamim" chutz mimmushek, shemmin chayya hu, shemmevarchin alav "bore mine besamim".
Metivi: en mevarchin "bore atze besamim" ella al afarsemon shel bet rabbi, veal afarsemon shel bet kesar, veal hahadas shebbechol makom!
Teyuveta.

Amar leh rav chisda lerav yitzchak: hay mishcha daafarsemon may mevarchin illaveh? amar leh, hachi amar rav yehuda: "bore shemen artzenu". amar leh: bar minneh derav yehuda dachaviva leh eretz yisrael, lechulle alma may?
Amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: "bore shemen arev".

Amar rav adda bar ahava: hay kesharta mevarchin illaveh "bore atze besamim", aval mishcha kevisha — la. verav kahana amar: afillu mishcha kevisha, aval mishcha techina — la. nehardae amri: afillu mishcha techina.
b: Amar rav giddel amar rav: hay simlak — mevarchin illaveh "bore atze besamim". amar rav chananel amar rav: hane chilfe deyamma — mevarchin alayyhu "bore atze besamim". amar mar zutera: may keraa — "vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz".

Rav mesharsheya amar: hay narkom deginunita — mevarchin illaveh "bore atze vesamim". dedavra — "bore isve vesamim". amar rav sheshet: hane sigle — mevarchin alayyhu "bore isve vesamim". amar mar zutera: hay man demorach beetroga o bechabbusha omer: "baruch shennatan reach tov bapperot".

Amar rav yehuda: hay man denafek beyome nisan vechaze ilane deka melavlevi, omer: "baruch shello chisser beolamo kelum uvara bo beriyyot tovot veilanot tovot lehitnaot bahen bene adam". amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: minnayin shemmevarchin al hareach? — shenneemar: "kol hanneshama tehallel yah". ezehu davar shehanneshama nehenet mimmennu veen hagguf nehene mimmennu? — heve omer: ze hareach.
Veamar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: atidim bachure yisrael sheyyittenu reach tov kallevanon. shenneemar: "yelchu yonkotav vihi chazzayit hodo vereach lo kallevanon".
Veamar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: may dichtiv "et hakkol asa yafe veitto" — melammed shekkol echad veechad yippa lo hakkadosh baruch hu ummanuto befanav.
Amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe: "tele leh kora ledavar acher, veihu dideh aved".

Veamar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: avuka kishnayim, veyareach kishlosha. ibbaya lehu: avuka kishnayim bahade dideh, o dilma avuka kishnayim levar middideh? ta shema: veyareach kishlosha, i amrat bishlama bahade dideh — shappir. ella i amrat levar middideh, arbaa lema li? vehaamar mar: leechad nire umazzik, lishnayim nire veeno mazzik, lishlosha eno nire kol ikkar. ella lav shema minna avuka kishnayim — bahade dideh. shema minna.

Veamar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, veamri la amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: noach lo leadam sheyyappil atzmo letoch kivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. menalan? — mittamar, shenneemar: "hi mutzet vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: heviu lefanav shemen vahadas, bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hashshemen veachar kach mevarech al hahadas. uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hahadas veachar kach mevarech al hashshemen. amar rabban gamliel: ani achria. shemen — zachinu lerecho vezachinu lesichato, hadas — lerecho zachinu lesichato lo zachinu. amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kedivre hammachria.

Rav pappa ikkela leve rav huna bereh derav ika. ayyto lekammayyhu shemen vahadas. shekal rav pappa barech ahadas beresha, vahadar barech ashshemen. amar leh: la savar la mar halacha kedivre hammachria? amar leh: hachi amar rava: halacha kevet hillel. vela hi, leishtemote nafsheh hu daavad.

Tanu rabbanan: heviu lifnehem shemen veyayin, bet shammay omrim: ochez hashshemen bimino veet hayyayin bismolo, mevarech al hashshemen vechozer umevarech al hayyayin. bet hillel omrim: ochez et hayyayin bimino veet hashshemen bismolo, mevarech al hayyayin vechozer umevarech al hashshemen, vetacho berosh hashshammash. veim shammash talmid chacham hu — tacho bakkotel, mippene sheggenay letalmid chacham latzet lashshuk keshehu mevussam.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim genay lo letalmid chacham: al yetze keshehu mevussam lashshuk, veal yetze yechidi ballayla, veal yetze beminalim hametullaim, veal yesapper im ishsha bashshuk, veal yasev bachavura shel amme haaretz, veal yikkanes baacharona levet hammidrash. veyesh omrim: af lo yafsia pesia gassa, veal yehallech bekoma zekufa.

Al yetze keshehu mevussam lashshuk: amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: bemakom shechashudim al mishkav zachur. amar rav sheshet: la amaran ella bevigdo, aval begufo — zea meabbera leh. amar rav pappa: usearo kevigdo dame, veamri la kegufo dame.
Veal yetze yechidi ballayla: mishshum chashada. vela amaran ella dela kevia leh iddana, aval kevia leh iddana — midda yedia diliddaneh ka azel.

Veal yetze beminalim hametullaim: mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: genay hu letalmid chacham sheyyetze beminalim hametullaim. ini? veha rabbi chiyyay bar abba nafek! amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: bitlay al gabbe telay. vela amaran ella befanta, aval begilda — let lan ba. uvefanta la amaran ella beorcha, aval beveta — let lan ba. vela amaran ella bimot hachamma, aval bimot haggeshamim — let lan ba.
Veal yesapper im ishsha bashshuk: amar rav chisda: vaafillu hi ishto. tanya name hachi: afillu hi ishto, vaafillu hi bitto, vaafillu hi achoto — lefi sheen hakkol bekiin bikrovotav.
Veal yasev bachavura shel amme haaretz: may tama? — dilma ate leimmeshoche batrayyhu.
Veal yikkanes baacharona levet hammidrash: mishshum dekaru leh "poshea".
Veyesh omrim, af lo yafsia pesia gassa: deamar mar, pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam. may takkanteh? lahdereh bekiddusha deve shimshe.
Veal yehallech bekoma zekufa: deamar mar hamehallech bekoma zekufa afillu arba ammot, keillu dochek ragle shechina, dichtiv: "melo chol haaretz kevodo".

a: Mishna heviu lefanav maliach techilla ufat immo — mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat, shehappat tefela lo. ze hakkelal: kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela — mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela.
Gemara umi ikka midde dehave maliach ikkar ufat tefela? amar rav acha bereh derav avvira amar rav ashe: beochle perot ginnosar shanu.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: ki hava azlinan batreh derabbi yochanan lemechal perot ginnosar, ki havenan be mea — menakketinan leh lechol chad vechad asra asra, vechi havenan be asra, menakketinan leh kol chad vechad mea mea. vechol mea minnayyhu hava machazik lehu tzanna bar telata save veachel lehu, umishteva dela teem ziyyuna. ziyyuna salka datach?! ella ema "mezona".

Rabbi avahu achel ad dahava sharek leh dudeva meapputeh. verav amme verav assi havo achli ad dintur mazayyhu. rabbi shimon ben lakish hava achel ad demared. veamar lehu rabbi yochanan lidve nesia vahava meshaddar leh rabbi yehuda nesia baloshe abbatreh, umayyti leh leveteh.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: ir achat hayta lo leyannay hammelech behar hammelech, shehayu motziim mimmenna shishshim ribbo sifle tarit lekotztze teenim meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Ki ata ravin amar: ilan echad haya lo leyannay hammelech behar hammelech, shehayu moridim mimmennu arbaim sea gozalot mishshalosh berechot bechodesh. ki ata rabbi yitzchak amar: ir achat hayta beeretz yisrael vegufenit shemah, shehayu bah shemonim zugot achim kohanim nesuim lishmonim zugot achayot kohanot. uvedaku rabbanan missura vead nehardaa vela ashkachu bar mibbenateh derav chisda, dahavo nesivan lerami bar chama ulemar ukeva bar chama. veaf al gav deinhi havo kahanata, inhu la havo kahane.
Amar rav: kol seuda sheen bah melach, enah seuda. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol seuda sheen bah serif, enah seuda.

Mishna achal anavim uteenim verimmonim — mevarech acharehem shalosh berachot, divre rabban gamliel. vachachamim omrim: beracha achat meen shalosh. rabbi akiva omer: afillu achal shelek vehu mezono — mevarech alav shalosh berachot. hashshote mayim litzmao — mevarech "shehakkol nihya bidvaro". rabbi tarfon omer: "bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan".
Gemara may tama derabban gamliel? dichtiv: "eretz chitta useora vegomer", uchetiv: "eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem vegomer", uchetiv: "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha".
Verabbanan "eretz" hifsik hainyan. verabban gamliel name "eretz" hifsik hainyan! hahu mibbee leh lemaote hakkoses et hachitta.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi chanina: kol shehu mechameshet hamminin, battechilla — mevarech alav "bore mine mezonot", ulevassof — beracha achat meen shalosh.
Amar rabba bar mari amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol shehu mishshivat hamminin, battechilla — mevarech "bore peri haetz", ulevassof — beracha achat meen shalosh.

Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: may nihu "beracha achat meen shalosh"? amar leh: appere deetz "al haetz veal peri haetz, veal tenuvat hassade, veal eretz chemda tova urechava shehinchalta laavotenu leechol mippiryah velisboa mittuvah. rachem Adonai elohenu al yisrael ammecha, veal yerushalayim irecha, veal mikdashcha, veal mizbechecha. vetivne yerushalayim ir kodshecha bimhera beyamenu. vehaalenu letochah, vesammechenu bah. ki atta tov umetiv lakkol".
Dachameshet hamminin: "al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal tenuvat hassade kulei". vechotem: "al haaretz veal hammichya".
Michtam bemay chatem? ki ata rav dimi amar: rav chatem berosh chodesh "baruch mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim", hacha may?
Rav chisda amar: "al haaretz veal peroteha". verabbi yochanan amar: "al haaretz veal happerot". amar rav amram, vela peligi: ha lan, veha lehu.
Matkif la rav nachman bar yitzchak: inhu achli, vaanan mevarchin?! ella efoch: rav chisda amar "al haaretz veal happerot", rabbi yochanan amar "al haaretz veal peroteha".
b: Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu: al habbea veal mine kufera, battechilla mevarech "shehakkol", ulevassof "bore nefashot rabbot vechulei". aval yarka la. verabbi yitzchak amar: afillu yarka, aval mayya — la. verav pappa amar: afillu mayya.
Mar zutera aved kerav yitzchak bar avdimi, verav shimi bar ashe aved kerabbi yitzchak. vesimanach: chad kitre, utere kechad.
Amar rav ashe: ana, zimna dechi middecharna, avedna kechullehu.

Tenan: kol shettaun beracha leacharav — taun beracha lefanav, veyesh shettaun beracha lefanav, veen taun beracha leacharav. bishlama lerav yitzchak bar avdimi, leappoke yarka. lerabbi yitzchak, leappoke mayya, ella lerav pappa, leappoke may?
Leappoke mitzvot.
Velivne maarva, devatar dimsalleki tefillayyhu mevarchi "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lishmor chukkav", leappoke may?
Leappoke rechane.

Amar rabbi yannay amar rabbi: kol shehu kevetza — betza tova mimmennu. ki ata ravin amar: tava beata megulegalta mishshitta keyayse suleta. ki ata rav dimi amar: tava beata megulegalta — mishshitta, mittevita — mearba, mevushalta — kol shehu kevetza, betza tova hemennu, levar mibbisra.
Rabbi akiva omer afillu achal shelek kulei: umi ikka midde dehave shelek mezone? amar rav ashe: bekelach shel keruv shanu.

Tanu rabbanan: techol yafe lashshinnayim vekashe livne meayim. kereshin kashin lashshinnayim veyafin livne meayim. kol yarak chay morik, vechol katan maktin, vechol nefesh meshiv et hannefesh, vechol karov lannefesh meshiv et hannefesh. keruv lemazon, uteradin lirfua. oy lo labbayit shehallefet overet betocho.
Amar mar: techol yafe lashshinnayim vekashe livne meayim. may takkanteh? nilaseh venishdeyeh.
Kereshin kashin lashshinnayim veyafin livne meayim. may takkanteh? lishlekinhu venivleinhu.
Kol yarak chay morik, amar rabbi yitzchak: bisuda rishona shel achar hakkaza.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol haochel yarak kodem arba shaot asur lesapper hemennu. may tama? mishshum recha. veamar rabbi yitzchak: asur leadam sheyyochal yarak chay kodem arba shaot.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havo yatvi, ayyto kammayyhu yarak chay kodem arba shaot. ammemar verav ashe achul umar zutera la achal. amaru leh: may dataych? deamar rabbi yitzchak kol haochel yarak kodem arba shaot asur lesapper hemennu mishshum recha? veha anan deka achlinan veka mishtaet bahadan!
Amar lehu: ana keiddach derabbi yitzchak sevira li. deamar rabbi yitzchak: asur leadam sheyyochal yarak chay kodem arba shaot.
Kol katan maktin, amar rav chisda: afillu gadya bar zuza. vela amaran ella delet beh riva, aval it beh riva — let lan bah.
Kol nefesh meshiv nefesh, amar rav pappa: afillu gildane deve gile.
Kol hakkarov lannefesh meshiv et hannefesh, amar rav acha bar yaakov: uneka. amar leh rava leshammaeh: ki mayytet li umetza devisra, terach veayyti li mehecha dimkarav leve "varuch".

Keruv lemazon uteradin lirfua. keruv lemazon in, velirfua la? veha tanya: shishsha devarim merappein et hachole mecholyo urefuatan refua, veellu hen: keruv uteradin ume sisin devash vekeva veheret veyoteret hakkaved! ella ema "keruv af lemazon".
Oy lo labbayit shehallefet overet betocho, ini?! veha amar leh rava leshammaeh: ki chazet lifta beshuka la tema li "bemay karchat rifta"!
Amar abbaye: mibbeli basar. verava amar: mibbeli yayin. ittemar rav amar: mibbeli basar. ushemuel amar: mibbeli etzim. verabbi yochanan amar: mibbeli yayin.

Amar leh rava lerav pappa: sudani, anan tavrinan la bevisra vechamra, attun dela nefish lechu chamra bemay tavritu la? amar leh: betzive, ki ha devethu derav pappa batar dimvashshela la, tavra la bitmanan ufe parseyayta.

Tanu rabbanan: dag katan maliach peamim shehu memit beshiva, beshiva asar, uveesrim veshiva. veamri la: beesrim ushelosha. vela amaran ella bemitteve vela mitteve, aval mitteve shappir — let lan ba. udela mitteve shappir, la amaran ella dela sheta batreh shichra, aval sheta batreh shichra — let lan ba.
Vehashshote mayim litzmao vechulei: leappoke may? amar rav idde bar avin: leappoke leman

a: Dachanakteh umetza.
Rabbi tarfon omer "bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan". amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye, veamri la lerav yosef: hilcheta may? amar leh: pok chazi may amma davar.
Haderan alach ketzad mevarchin

Mishna shelosha sheachlu keachat, chayyayvin lezammen. achal demay, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehashshammash sheachal kezayit, vehakkuti — mezammenin alav.

Achal tevel, umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkazzayit, vehannochri — en mezammenin alav. nashim vaavadim uketannim — en mezammenin alehen. ad kamma mezammenin? — ad kezayit. rabbi yehuda omer: ad kevetza.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav assi: deamar kera "gaddelu laAdonai itti uneromma shemo yachdav". rabbi avahu amar: mehacha: "ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu".
Amar rav chanan bar abba: minnayin laone "amen" shello yagbiah kolo yoter min hamevarech — shenneemar: "gaddelu laAdonai itti uneromma shemo yachdav".

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: minnayin sheen hametargem rashshay lehagebiah kolo yoter min hakkore, shenneemar: "moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol", sheen talmud lomar "vekol", uma talmud lomar "vekol" — bekolo shel moshe.
Tanya name hachi: en hametargem rashshay lehagebiah kolo yoter min hakkore. veim i efshar lamtargem lehagebiah kolo keneged hakkore — yemaech hakkore kolo veyikra.
Ittemar: shenayim sheachlu keachat, peligi rav verabbi yochanan. chad amar: im ratzu lezammen — mezammenin, vechad amar: im ratzu lezammen — en mezammenin.
Tenan: shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyayvin lezammen. shelosha — in, shenayim — la!
Hatam chova, hacha reshut.
Ta shema: shelosha sheachlu keachat — chayyayvin lezammen, veen rashshain lechalek. shelosha — in, shenayim — la!
Shane hatam dekavu lehu bechova meikkara.

Ta shema: hashshammash shehaya meshammesh al hashshenayim — hare ze ochel immahem, af al pi shello natnu lo reshut. haya meshammesh al hashshelosha — hare ze eno ochel immahem, ella im ken natnu lo reshut!
Shane hatam
b: Denicha lehu demakba lehu bechova meikkara.

Ta shema: nashim mezammenot leatzman, vaavadim mezammenim leatzman, nashim vaavadim uketannim im ratzu lezammen — en mezammenin. veha nashim afillu mea veha mea nashe kitre gavre damyayn, vekatane nashim mezammenot leatzman vaavadim mezammenin leatzman!
Shane hatam deikka deot.
I hachi, ema sefa: nashim vaavadim im ratzu lezammen — en mezammenin. ammay la, veha ikka deot!
Shane hatam mishshum peritzuta.

Tistayyem, derav deamar im ratzu lezammen — en mezammenin. deamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rav: shelosha sheachlu keachat veyatza echad mehem lashshuk — korin lo umezammenin alav. tama dekorin lo, ha lo korin lo — la!
Shane hatam deikkevau lehu bechova meikkara.
Ella tistayyem, derabbi yochanan hu deamar im ratzu lezammen — en mezammenin, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shenayim sheachlu keachat — echad mehen yotze bevirkat chavero.
Vahavenan ba: may ka mashma lan, tenena: shama velo ana — yatza! veamar rabbi zera lomar sheen birkat hazzimmun benehem. tistayyem.
Amar leh rava bar rav huna lerav huna: veha rabbanan daato mimmareva amri, im ratzu lezammen — mezammenin, may lav dishmia lehu merabbi yochanan? la, dishmia lehu merav, mikkamme dinchet levavel.
Gufa. amar rav dimi bar yosef amar rav: shelosha sheachlu keachat, veyatza echad mehem lashshuk — korin lo, umezammenin alav. amar abbaye: vehu dekaru leh veane.
Amar mar zutera: vela amaran, ella bishlosha, aval baasara ad denete.
Matkef la rav ashe: adderabba ippecha mistabbera tisha nirin kaasara, shenayim en nirin kishlosha.
Vehilcheta kemar zutera. may tama? — kevan devae leadkore shem shamayim — betzir measara lav orach ara.

Amar abbaye: nekitinan shenayim sheachlu keachat — mitzva lechalek. tanya name hachi: shenayim sheachlu keachat — mitzva lechalek. bamme devarim amurim, kesheshshenehem sofrim, aval echad sofer veechad bur — sofer mevarech, uvur yotze.
Amar rava: ha milleta amrita ana, veittamra mishshemeh derabbi zera kevoti: shelosha sheachlu keachat, echad mafsik lashshenayim, veen shenayim mafsikin laechad.
Vela? veha rav pappa afsek leh leabba mar bereh ihu vechad! shane rav pappa, delifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad.

Yehuda bar marimar umar bar rav ashe verav acha middifti karchi rifta bahade hadade, la hava behu chad dahava mufelag mechavreh levaroche lehu. yatvi veka mibbaya lehu: ha ditnan shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyayvin lezammen, hane mille hecha deikka adam gadol, aval hecha dechi hadade ninhu — chilluk berachot adif.
Barech inish lenafsheh. ato lekammeh demarimar. amar lehu: yede beracha yetzatem, yede zimmun lo yetzatem. vechi temru: nehdar unezammen, en zimmun lemafrea.
Ba umetzaan keshehen mevarchim, mahu omer acharehem? rav zevid amar: "baruch umevorach". rav pappa amar: one "amen".
Vela peligi, ha — deashkechinhu deka amri "nevarech", veha — deashkechinhu deka amri "baruch". ashkechinhu deka amri "nevarech" — omer "baruch umevorach", ashkechinhu deka amri "baruch" — one "amen".
Tane chada: haone "amen" achar birchotav — hare ze meshubbach. vetanya iddach: hare ze megunne.
La kashya, ha — bevone yerushalayim". ha — bishar berachot.
Abbaye ane leh bekala, ki hechi delishmeu poalim velekumu, dehattov vehammetiv" lav deorayyta. rav ashe ane leh bilchisha, ki hechi dela nezalzelu behattov vehammetiv".

a: Rabbi zera chalash, al legabbeh rabbi avahu, kabbel aleh: i mittefach kattina charich shake — avedna yoma tava lerabbanan. ittefach, avad seodta lechullehu rabbanan. ki meta lemishre amar leh lerabbi zera: lishre lan mar. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derabbi yochanan deamar: baal habbayit botzea? shera lehu.
Ki meta levaroche, amar leh: nevarech lan mar. amar leh: la savar la mar leha derav huna demin bavel deamar: botzea mevarech?
Veihu, keman sevira leh?

Ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: baal habbayit botzea, veoreach mevarech. baal habbayit botzea — kede sheyyivtza beayin yafa. veoreach mevarech — kede sheyyevarech baal habbayit.
May mevarech — "yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze, velo yikkalem leolam habba".

Verabbi mosif bah devarim: "veyitzlach meod bechol nechasav, veyihyu nechasav unechasenu mutzelachim ukerovim lair, veal yishlot satan lo bemaase yadav velo bemaase yadenu, veal yizdakker lo lefanav velo lefanenu shum devar hirhur chet vaavera veavon meatta vead olam".
Ad hechan birkat hazzimmun.
Rav nachman amar ad "nevarech", verav sheshet amar, ad "hazzan".

Nema ketannae, detane chada: birkat hammazon shenayim ushelosha, vetanya iddach: shelosha vearbaa. savruha, dechulle alma "hattov vehammetiv" lav deorayyta hi, may lav beha kamippalgi: man deamar shetayim veshalosh kasavar ad "hazzan". — uman deamar shalosh vearba kasavar ad "nevarech".
La, rav nachman metaretz letameh, verav sheshet metaretz letameh:

Rav nachman metaretz letameh, dechulle alma ad "nevarech". man deamar shalosh vearba — shappir, uman deamar shetayim veshalosh — amar lach hacha bevirkat poalim askinan, deamar mar, poteach behazzan" vecholel "bone yerushalayim" bevirkat haaretz.
Rav sheshet metaretz letameh, dechulle alma ad "hazzan". man deamar shetayim veshalosh — shappir, uman deamar shalosh vearba kasavar "hattov vehammetiv" deorayyta hi.
Amar rav yosef: tidda dehattov vehammetiv" lav deorayyta — shehare poalim okrim otah.

Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav tidda dehattov vehammetiv" lav deorayyta shehare poteach bah bevaruch" veen chotem bah bevaruch", kidtanya: kol habberachot kullan poteach bahen bevaruch" vechotem bahen bevaruch", chutz mibbirkat happerot uvirkat hammitzvot, uveracha hassemucha lachavertah, uveracha acharona shebbikriat shema, yesh mehen sheppoteach bahen bevaruch" veen chotem bevaruch",
b: Veyesh mehen shechotem bahen bevaruch" veen poteach bevaruch". vehattov vehammetiv" poteach bevaruch" veen chotem bevaruch". mikkelal divracha bifne atzmah hi.

Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tidda dehattov vehammetiv" lav deorayyta — shehare okrin otah bevet haevel. kidtanya: ma hem omrim bevet haevel? — "baruch hattov vehammetiv". rabbi akiva omer: "baruch dayyayn haemet".
"Hattov vehammetiv" — in, "dayyayn emet" — la?! ella ema af "hattov vehammetiv".

Mar zutera ikkela leve rav ashe, ittera beh milleta, petach uvarech: "hattov vehammetiv, el emet, dayyayn emet, shofet betzedek, lokeach bammishpat, veshallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono, ki chol derachav mishpat, shehakkol shello vaanachnu ammo vaavadav, uvakkol anachnu chayyayvim lehodot lo ulevarcho, goder peratzot beyisrael hu yigdor et happirtza hazzot beyisrael lechayyim".
Lehechan hu chozer? rav zevid mishshemeh deabbaye amar: chozer larosh, verabbanan amri lammakom sheppasak, vehilcheta lammakom sheppasak.

Amar leh resh galuta lerav sheshet: af al gav derabbanan kashshishe attun, parsae betzorche seuda bekii minnayychu. bizman shehen shete mittot, gadol — mesev barosh, vesheni lo — lemala hemennu. uvizman shehem shalosh, gadol — mesev baemtza, sheni lo — lemala hemennu, shelishi lo — lematta hemennu.
Amar leh, vechi bae ishtaoye bahadeh, metaretz tarotze veyatev umishtae bahadeh?! amar leh: shane parsae, demachve leh bemachog.
Mayim rishonim mehechan matchilin? amar leh: min haggadol.
Yeshev gadol veyishmor yadav ad shennotlin kullan? amar leh: lealtar mayytu takka kammeh.
Mayim acharonim mehechan matchilin? amar leh: min hakkatan.
Vegadol yatev veyadav mezohamot ad shennotlin kullan? amar leh: la mesalleki takka mikkammeh ad denimte mayya legabbeh.

Amar rav sheshet: ana matnita yadana, detanya: ketzad seder hasibba? — bizman shehen shete mittot — gadol mesev barosh, vesheni lo lematta hemennu. bizman shehen shalosh mittot — gadol mesev barosh, sheni lo lemala hemennu, shelishi lo lematta hemennu. mayim harishonim matchilin min haggadol. mayim acharonim, bizman shehem chamishsha — matchilin min haggadol, uvizman shehem mea — matchilin min hakkatan ad shemmaggiim etzel chamishi, vechozrin umatchilin min haggadol. velimkom shemmayim acharonim chozrin — lesham beracha chozeret.
Mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: kol hannotel yadav baacharona techilla — hu mezumman livracha.
Rav verabbi chiyyay havo yatvi bisodta kammeh derabbi, amar leh rabbi lerav: kum, meshi yedach. chazyeh deka merattet. amar leh: bar pachate, "ayyen bevirkat mezona" kaamar lach.
Tanu rabbanan: en mechabbedin lo bidrachim velo bigsharim,

a: Velo beyadayim mezohamot.

Ravin veabbaye havo ka azli beorcha, kadmeh chamareh derabbin lidabbaye vela amar leh "nezil mar". amar: middislik hay merabbanan mimmareva, gas leh dateh. ki meta lefitcha deve chenishta amar leh: neal mar. amar leh: vead hasheta lav mar ana? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: en mechabbedin ella befetach sheyyesh bah mezuza.
Deit ba mezuza — in, delet ba mezuza — la, ella meatta, bet hakkeneset uvet hammidrash, delet behu mezuza, hachi name deen mechabbedin? ella ema: befetach harauy limzuza.
Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: en hamesubbin rashshain leechol kelum ad sheyyitom habbotzea. yatev rav safra vekaamar: "litom" ittemar.
Lemay nafka minna? shechayyayv adam lomar bilshon rabbo.
Tanu rabbanan: shenayim mamtinin ze laze bakkeara, shelosha — en mamtinin. habbotzea hu poshet yado techilla, veim ba lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol hemennu — harshut beyado.

Rabba bar bar chana hava asek leh livreh be rav shemuel bar rav kattina, kadem veyatev vekamatne leh livreh: en habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyichle "amen" mippi haonim. rav chisda amar mippi rov haonim.
Amar lo rame bar chama: may shena rubba — deakkatti la kalya beracha, miuta name la kalya beracha?
Amar leh: sheani omer, kol haone "amen" yoter midday — eno ella toe.
Tanu rabbanan: en onin lo "amen" chatufa, velo "amen" ketufa, velo "amen" yetoma, velo yizrok beracha mippiv.
Ben azzay omer: kol haone "amen" yetoma — yihyu banav yetomim, chatufa — yitchattefu yamav, ketufa — yitkattefu yamav. vechol hammaarich beamen" — maarichin lo yamav ushenotav.

Rav ushemuel havo yatvi bisodta. ata rav shimi bar chiyyay, hava kamsarhev veachel. amar leh rav: ma datach — leitzterofe bahadan, anan achilna lan. amar leh shemuel: illu mayytu li ardilayya vegozalayya leabba, mi la achlinan?

Talmide derav havo yatvi bisodta. al rav acha. amri: ata gavra rabba dimvarech lan. amar lehu: mi savritu degadol mevarech? ikkar shebbasseuda mevarech. vehilcheta gadol mevarech, af al gav daata levassof.

Achal demay vechulei: ha la chaze leh! kevan dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani, vachaze leh, ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay, veet haachsanya demay. veamar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim veet haachsanya demay.

Maaser rishon shennittela terumato: peshita? la tzericha ella shehikdimo bashshibbolim, vehifrish mimmennu terumat maaser, velo hifrish mimmennu teruma gedola, vechidrabbi avahu. deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolim — patur mitteruma gedola, shenneemar: "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser" — maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha, velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, afillu hikdimo bichri name! amar leh: alecha amar kera
b: "Mikkol maserotechem tarimu". uma raita? hay iddegan vehay la iddegan.
Maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu: peshita! hacha bemay askinan — kegon shennatan et hakkeren, velo natan et hachomesh. veha ka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev.
Hashshammash sheachal kezayit: peshita! mahu detema: shammash la kava — ka mashma lan.
Vehakkuti mezammenin alav: ammay? lo yehe ella am haaretz! vetanya en mezammenin al am haaretz!

Abbaye amar bechuti chaver. rava amar: afillu tema bechuti am haaretz, vehacha beam haaretz derabbanan difligi aleh derabbi meir askinan, detanya: ezehu am haaretz? — kol sheeno ochel chullav betohora, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol sheeno measser perotav karauy. vehane kutae assore measseri kedachaze, divmay dichtiv beorayyta mizhar zehiri. deamar mar kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim — harebe medakdekin bah, yoter miyyisrael.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu am haaretz? — kol sheeno kore keriat shema arvit veshacharit, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer: kol sheeno manniach tefillin. ben azzay omer: kol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo. rabbi natan omer: kol sheen mezuza al pitcho. rabbi natan bar yosef omer: kol sheyyesh lo banim veeno megaddelam letalmud tora. acherim omrim: afillu kara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim hare ze am haaretz. amar rav huna: halacha kaacherim.

Rame bar chama la azmen aleh derav menashsheya bar tachlifa detane sifra vesifre vehilcheta. ki nach nafsheh derame bar chama, amar rava: la nach nafsheh derame bar chama ella dela azmen arav menashsheya bar tachlifa. vehatanya — acherim omrim afillu kara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim hare ze am haaretz? shane rav menashsheya bar tachlifa dimshamma lehu lerabbanan, verame bar chama hu dela dak abbatreh. lishshana acharina: deshama shematata mippummayyhu derabbanan vegares lehu — ketzorva merabbanan dame.
Achal tevel umaaser vechulei: tevel peshita! la tzericha betevel tavul midderabbanan. hechi dame — beatzitz sheeno nakuv.
Maaser rishon kulei: peshita! la tzericha kegon shehikdimo bichri. mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye — ka mashma lan kidshanni leh.

Maaser sheni vechulei: peshita! la tzericha, shennifdu velo nifdu kehilchatan. maaser sheni — kegon sheppedao al gabbe asimon, verachamana amar: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha" — kesef sheyyesh lo alav tzura. hekdesh — shechillelo al gabbe karka, velo pedao bechesef, verachamana amar: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".
Vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkezayit: peshita! ayyeydi ditna resha "kezayit", tena sefa "pachot mikkezayit".
Vehannochri en mezammenin alav: peshita! hacha bemay askinan, beger shemmal velo taval. deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi yochanan: leolam eno ger ad sheyyimmol veyitbol, vechamma dela teval goy hu.
Nashim vaavadim uketannim en mezammenin alehen. amar rabbi yose: katan hammuttal baarisa mezammenin alav.
Veha tenan: nashim vaavadim uketannim en mezammenin alehem!
Hu deamar kerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: af al pi sheamru katan hammuttal baarisa en mezammenin alav, aval osin oto senif laasara.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: tisha veeved — mitztarfin. metivi: maase berabbi eliezer shennichnas levet hakkeneset velo matza asara, veshichrer avdo vehishlimo laasara. shichrer — in, lo shichrer — la. tere itzterichu, shachrer chad venafek bechad.
Vehechi aved hachi? vehaamar rav yehuda kol hameshachrer avdo over baase, shenneemar: "leolam bahem taavodu"? lidvar mitzva shane: mitzva habbaa baavera hi! — mitzva derabbim shane.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: leolam yashkim adam levet hakkeneset kede sheyyizke veyimmane im asara harishonim, sheafillu mea baim acharav — kibbel alav sechar kullam. "sechar kullam" salka datach?! ella ema: notnin lo sachar keneged kullam.
Amar rav huna: tisha vearon — mitztarfin. amar leh rav nachman: vearon gavra hu? ella amar rav huna: tisha nirin kaasara — mitztarfin. amri la: ki mechannefi. veamri la: ki mevadderi.

Amar rav amme: shenayim veshabbat mitztarfin. amar leh rav nachman: veshabbat gavra hu?! ella amar rabbi amme: shene talmide chachamim hamechaddedin ze et ze bahalacha mitztarfin. machve rav chisda: kegon ana verav sheshet. machve rav sheshet: kegon ana verav chisda.

Amar rabbi yochanan: katan poreach — mezammenin alav. tanya name hachi: katan shehevi shete searot — mezammenin alav, veshello hevi shete searot — en mezammenin alav, veen medakdekin bekatan. ha gufa kashya, amrat: hevi shete searot — in, la hevi — la. vahadar tane en medakdekin bekatan. leetuye may? lav

a: Leetuye katan poreach?
Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata, ella ki ha deamar rav nachman: katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin — mezammenin alav.

Abbaye verava havo yatvi kammeh derabba. amar lehu rabba: lemi mevarchin? amri leh: lerachamana. verachamana hecha yatev? — rava achvi lishme telala. abbaye nefak levara, achvi kelappe shemayya. amar lehu rabba: tarvayychu rabbanan havetu. hayeynu deamri inashe: butzin butzin mikkitfeh yedia.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: tisha achlu dagan veechad achal yarak — mitztarfin. amar rabbi zera: beay minneh merav yehuda: shemona mahu? shiva mahu? amar li: la shena. shishsha vadday la mibbaya li. amar leh rabbi yirmeya: shappir avadt dela ibbaya lecha, hatam tama may — mishshum deikka rubba, hacha name ikka rubba. veihu savar rubba deminnechar baenan.

Yannay malka umalketa kerichu rifta bahade hadade, umiddiktal lehu lerabbanan la hava leh inish levaroche lehu. amar la lidvethu: man yahev lan gavra dimvarech lan? amara leh: ishteva li dei mayytena lach gavra dela metzaarat leh. ishteva la. ayytiteh leshimon ben shatach achuha. otveh ben dideh ledida. amar leh: chazet kamma yekara avedna lach. amar leh: lav at ka mokrat li ella orayyta hi demokra li, dichtiv: "salseleha uterommekka techabbedcha ki techabbekenna". amar la: ka chazet dela mekabbel marut.
Yehavu leh kasa levaroche. amar: hechi avarech — "baruch sheachal yannay vachaverav mishshello"? shatyeh lehahu kasa, yehavu leh kasa acharina uvarech.

Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shimon ben shatach daavad — legarmeh hu daavad, dehachi amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: leolam eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan.
Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ala vehesev immahem afillu lo tibbel immahem ella betzir, velo achal immahem ella gerogeret achat — mitztaref.
Itzterofe mitztaref aval lehotzi et harabbim yede chovatan — ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan.
Ittemar name, amar rav chana bar yehuda mishshemeh derava: afillu lo
b: Tibbel immahem ella betzir, velo achal immahem ella gerogeret achat — mitztaref. ulehotzi et harabbim yede chovatam — eno motzi ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan. amar rav chana bar yehuda mishshemeh derava: hilcheta, achal ale yarak veshata kos shel yayin — mitztaref. lehotzi — eno motzi ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan.

Amar rav nachman: moshe tikken leyisrael birkat "hazzan" beshaa sheyyarad lahem man. yehoshua tikken lahem birkat haaretz kevan shennichnesu laaretz. david ushelomo tikkenu "bone yerushalayim". david tikken "al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha", ushelomo tikken "al habbayit haggadol vehakkadosh". "hattov vehammetiv" beyavne tikkenuha keneged haruge betar. deamar rav matna: oto hayyom shennittenu haruge betar likvura tiknu beyavne "hattov vehammetiv". "hattov" — shello hisrichu, "vehammetiv" — shennittenu likvura.

Tanu rabbanan, seder birkat hammazon kach hi: beracha rishona — birkat "hazzan", sheniyya — birkat haaretz, shelishit — "bone yerushalayim", reviit — "hattov vehammetiv", uveshabbat — matchil benechama umesayyem benechama, veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza. rabbi eliezer omer: ratza leomrah bannechama — omrah, bevirkat haaretz — omrah, bivracha shettikkenu chachamim beyavne — omrah. vachachamim omrim: eno omrah ella bannechama bilvad.
Chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma? — ikka benayyhu diavad.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin levirkat hammazon min hattora? — shenneemar: "veachalta vesavata uverachta" — zo birkat "hazzan", "et Adonai elohecha" — zo birkat hazzimmun, "al haaretz" — zo birkat haaretz, "hattova" — zo "bone yerushalayim", vechen hu omer "hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon". "asher natan lach" — zo "hattov vehammetiv". en li ella leacharav, lefanav minnayin? — amrat kal vachomer: keshehu savea mevarech, keshehu raev — lo kol shekken.

Rabbi omer [eno tzarich]: "veachalta vesavata uverachta" — zo birkat hazzan, aval birkat hazzimmun miggaddelu laAdonai itti" nafka. "al haaretz" — zo birkat haaretz, "hattova" — zo "bone yerushalayim", vechen hu omer "hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon". "hattov vehammetiv" beyavne tikkenuha. en li ella leacharav, lefanav minnayin? talmud lomar: "asher natan lach" — mishshennatan lach.
Rabbi yitzchak omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "uverach et lachmecha veet memecha", al tikre "uverach" ella "uvarech". veematay karuy "lechem" — kodem sheyyochlennu.
Rabbi natan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "kevoachem hair ken timtzeun oto beterem yaale habbamata leechol ki lo yochal haam ad boo ki hu yevarech hazzevach achare chen yochlu hakkeruim".

Vechol kach lamma? lefi shehannashim dabberaniyyot hen. ushemuel amar: kede lehistakkel beyofyo shel shaul, dichtiv: "mishshichmo vamala gavoah mikkol haam". verabbi yochanan amar: lefi sheen malchut nogaat bachavertah afillu kimlo nima.

Veen li ella birkat hammazon. birkat hattora minnayin? amar rabbi yishmael: kal vachomer, al chayye shaa mevarech, al chayye olam habba lo kol shekken. rabbi chiyyay bar nachmani talmido shel rabbi yishmael omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "al haaretz hattova asher natan lach", ulehallan hu omer: "veettena lach et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva vegomer".

Rabbi meir omer: uminnayin shekkeshem shemmevarech al hattova kach mevarech al haraa? talmud lomar: "asher natan lecha Adonai elohecha", dayyayncha, bechol din sheddancha, ben midda tova uven middat pureanut.

Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "tova", "hattova". tova — zo tora, vechen hu omer: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem". "hattova" — zo binyan yerushalayim, vechen hu omer "hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon".

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer: kol shello amar "eretz chemda tova urechava" bevirkat haaretz, umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim" — lo yatza yede chovato. nachum hazzaken omer: tzarich sheyyizkor bah berit. rabbi yose omer: tzarich sheyyizkor bah tora. pelemo omer: tzarich sheyyakdim berit letora, shezzo nittena beshalosh beritot,

a: Vezo nittena bishlosh esre beritot.
Rabbi abba omer: tzarich sheyyomar bah hodaa techilla vasof. vehappochet lo yifchot meachat. vechol happochet meachat — hare ze megunne.

Vechol hachotem "manchil aratzot" bevirkat haaretz, umoshia et yisrael" bevone yerushalayim" — hare ze bur. vechol sheeno omer berit vetora bevirkat haaretz, umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim" — lo yatza yede chovato.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi ila, deamar rabbi ila amar rabbi yaakov bar acha mishshum rabbenu: kol shello amar berit vetora bevirkat haaretz umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim" — lo yatza yede chovato.

Peligi ba abba yose ben dostay verabbanan. chad amar: "hattov vehammetiv" tzericha malchut, vechad amar: enah tzericha malchut. man deamar tzericha malchut kasavar derabbanan. uman deamar enah tzericha malchut kasavar deorayyta.
Tanu rabbanan: mahu chotem bevinyan yerushalayim, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: "moshia yisrael". "moshia yisrael" — in, "bone yerushalayim" — la? ella ema: af "moshia yisrael".
Rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve resh galuta, petach bachada vesayyem betarte. amar rav chisda: gevureta lemechtam betarte! vehatanya rabbi omer: en chotmin bishtayim!
Gufa. rabbi omer: en chotmin bishtayim. etiveh levi lerabbi, "al haaretz veal hammazon"! — eretz demappeka mazon. "al haaretz veal happerot"! — eretz demappeka perot.
"Mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim"! — yisrael dekaddeshinhu lizmannim. "mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim"! — yisrael dekaddeshinhu lerashe chodashim.
"Mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim"! — chutz mizzo.
Umay shena? hacha chada hi, hatam tarte, kol chada vachada beappe nafshah.
Vetama may en chotmin bishtayim? lefi sheen osin mitzvot chavilot chavilot.
May have ala?

Amar rav sheshet: patach berachem al ammecha yisrael" — chotem bemoshia yisrael. patach berachem al yerushalayim" — chotem bevone yerushalayim". verav nachman amar: afillu patach berachem al yisrael" — chotem bevone yerushalayim", mishshum shenneemar "bone yerushalayim Adonai nidche yisrael yechannes": ematay bone yerushalayim Adonai — bizman shennidche yisrael yechannes.

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav chisda: nete mar venitne. amar leh: birkat mezona la gemirna, vetannoye matnena. amar leh: may hay? amar leh: deikkelai leve resh galuta, uvarechi birkat mezona, vezakfeh rav sheshet lekoeh alay kechivya. veammay? dela amari lo berit velo tora velo malchut. veammay la amart? kidrav chananel amar rav, deamar rav chananel amar rav: lo amar berit vetora umalchut — yatza. berit — lefi sheenah benashim. tora umalchut — lefi sheenan lo benashim velo baavadim. veat shevakt kol hane tannae veamorae, vaavadt kerav?!

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: "hattov vehammetiv" tzericha malchut. may ka mashma lan, kol beracha sheen bah malchut — lo shemah beracha? veha amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna! amar rabbi zera: lomar shetztzericha shete malchuyot, chada dida vachada devone yerushalayim".

I hachi nive telat: chada dida, vachada devone yerushalayim", vachada devirkat haaretz! ella birkat haaretz may tama la? mishshum dehavyay la beracha hassemucha lachavertah, "bone yerushalayim" name la tive, dehavya la beracha hassemucha lachavertah!
Hu haddin daafillu "bone yerushalayim" name la baaya. ayyeyde deamar malchut bet david, lav orach ara dela amar malchut shamayim. rav pappa amar, hachi kaamar: tzericha shete malchuyot levar middida.

Yatev rabbi zera achore derav giddel, veyatev rav giddel kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: taa velo hizkir shel shabbat, omer: "baruch shennatan shabbatot limnucha leammo yisrael beahava leot velivrit, baruch mekaddesh hashshabbat". amar leh: man amra? rav.
Hadar yatev vekaamar: taa velo hizkir shel yom tov, omer: "baruch shennatan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesimcha ulezikkaron, baruch mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim". amar leh: man amra? rav.

Hadar yatev vekaamar: taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh omer "baruch shennatan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron". vela yadana i amar bah "simcha" i la amar bah "simcha", i chatem bah, i la chatem bah, i dideh i derabbeh.
Giddel bar minyome hava kae kammeh derav nachman, tea rav nachman
b: Vahadar leresha. amar leh: may tama aved mar hachi? amar leh, deamar rabbi shela amar rav: taa — chozer larosh.

Veha amar rav huna amar rav: taa — omer "baruch shennatan"! amar leh: lav ittemar ala, amar rav menashsheya bar tachlifa amar rav: lo shanu ella shello patach behattov vehammetiv", aval patach behattov vehammetiv" — chozer larosh.
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rav nachman amar shemuel: taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh battefilla — machazirin oto. bevirkat hammazon — en machazirin oto.

Amar leh rav avin lerav amram: may shena tefilla umay shena birkat hammazon? amar leh: af ledidi kashya li usheelteh lerav nachman, vaamar li: minneh demar shemuel la shemia li, ella nechze anan: tefilla dechova hi — machazirin oto. birkat mezona, dei bae achel i bae la achel — en machazirin oto.

Ella meatta shabbatot veyamim tovim, dela saggi dela achel — hachi name dei tae hadar? — amar leh: in, deamar rabbi shela amar rav: taa — chozer larosh. veha amar rav huna amar rav: taa — omer "baruch shennatan"! — lav ittemar ala: lo shanu ella shello patach behattov vehammetiv", aval patach behattov vehammetiv" — chozer larosh.
Ad kamma mezammenin vechulei.

Lememra derabbi meir chashev leh kezayit, verabbi yehuda kevetza? veha ippecha shaminan lehu, ditnan: vechen mi sheyyatza miyyerushalayim venizkar shehaya beyado besar kodesh, im avar tzofim — sorfo bimkomo, veim lav — chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha.
Ad kamma hem chozrim? rabbi meir omer: ze veze bichvetza. verabbi yehuda omer: ze veze bichzayit.

Amar rabbi yochanan: muchelefet hashshita. abbaye amar: leolam la tefoch. hacha bikrae peligi, rabbi meir savar: "veachalta" — zo achila, "vesavata" — zo shetiyya, vaachila bichzayit. verabbi yehuda savar: "veachalta vesavata" — achila sheyyesh bah sevia, veezo zo — kevetza.
Hatam bisvara peligi, rabbi meir savar: chazarato ketumeato, ma tumeato bichvetza — af chazarato bichvetza. verabbi yehuda savar: chazarato keissuro, ma issuro bichzayit — af chazarato bichzayit.
Mishna ketzad mezammenin? bishlosha — omer: "nevarech", bishlosha vahu — omer: "barchu".
Baasara — omer "nevarech elohenu", baasara vahu — omer "barchu". echad asara veechad asara ribbo.

Bemea — hu omer "nevarech Adonai elohenu", bemea vahu — omer "barchu". uveelef — hu omer "nevarech laAdonai elohenu elohe yisrael", beelef vahu — omer "barchu". beribbo — omer "nevarech laAdonai elohenu elohe yisrael elohe tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu", beribbo vahu — omer "barchu".
Kainyan shehu mevarech, kach onim acharav "baruch Adonai elohenu elohe yisrael elohe tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu".

Rabbi yose haggelili omer: lefi rov hakkahal hem mevarchim, shenneemar "bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael". amar rabbi akiva: ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset, echad merubbim veechad muatim omer "barchu et Adonai". rabbi yishmael omer: "barchu et Adonai hamevorach".
Gemara amar shemuel: leolam al yotzi adam et atzmo min hakkelal.
Tenan: bishlosha vahu — omer "barchu"!
Ema:

a: Af "barchu", umikkol makom "nevarech" adif, deamar rav adda bar ahava, amri be rav, tenena: shishsha nechlakin ad asara.
I amrat bishlama "nevarech" adif — mishshum hachi nechlakin, ella i amrat "barchu" adif — ammay nechlakin! ella lav shema minna "nevarech" adif. shema minna.

Tanya name hachi: ben sheamar "barchu" ben sheamar "nevarech" — en tofsin oto al kach, vehannakdanin tofsin oto al kach. umibbirchotav shel adam nikkar im talmid chacham hu im lav. ketzad? rabbi omer: "uvetuvo" — hare ze talmid chacham, "umittuvo" — hare ze bur.
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: vehachtiv: "umibbirchatcha yevorach (et) bet avdecha leolam"! — bishela shane. bishela name, hachtiv: "harechev picha vaamalleehu"! — hahu, bedivre tora ketiv.
Tanya, rabbi omer: "betuvo chayinu" — hare ze talmid chacham, "chayyim" — hare ze bur. neharbelae matni ippecha, velet hilchata kinharbelae.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "nevarech sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze talmid chacham, "lemi sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze bur.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: veha amrinan "lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu". amar leh: hatam mochcha milleta, man aved nisse — kudesha berich hu.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "baruch sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze talmid chacham, "al hammazon sheachalnu" — hare ze bur.

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran ella bishlosha, delekka shem shamayim, aval baasara, deikka shem shamayim — mochcha milleta, keditnan: kainyan shehu mevarech, kach onin acharav: "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu".
Echad asara, veechad asara ribbo. ha gufa kashya, amrat echad asara veechad asara ribbo, alma ki hadade ninhu, vahadar katane bemea omer, beelef omer, beribbo omer!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha rabbi yose haggelili, ha rabbi akiva. ditnan, rabbi yose haggelili omer: lefi rov hakkahal hem mevarchin, shenneemar: "bemakhelot barchu elohim".

Amar rabbi akiva: ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset vechulei. verabbi akiva, hay kera derabbi yose haggelili may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya, haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu ubbarin shebbime imman amru shira al hayyam — shenneemar: "bemakhelot barchu elohim Adonai mimmekor yisrael". veiddach? mimmekor" nafka.
Amar rava: halacha kerabbi akiva. ravina verav chama bar buzi ikkelau leve resh galuta. kam rav chama veka mehaddar abbe mea. amar leh ravina: la tzerichat, hachi amar rava: halacha kerabbi akiva.

Amar rava: ki achlinan rifta be resh galuta, mevarchinan shelosha shelosha. velivarchu asara asara! — shema resh galuta veikkefad. venippeku bevirketa deresh galuta! — ayyeyde deavvshu kulle alma, la shami.
Amar rabba tosfaa: hane shelosha decharchi rifta bahade hadade, ukedem chad minnayyhu uvarech ledateh — innun nafkin bezimmun dideh, ihu la nafek bezimmun didhu — lefi sheen zimmun lemafrea.

Rabbi yishmael omer. rafram bar pappa ikkela leve kenishta daavi gibbar, kam kera besifra vaamar "barchu et Adonai", veishtik, vela amar "hamevorach". avavshu kulle alma: "barchu et Adonai hamevorach". amar rava: patya ukkama, bahade pelugeta lema lecha? veod, ha nehug alma kerabbi yishmael.
Mishna shelosha sheachlu keachat — enan rashshain lechalek. vechen arbaa, vechen chamishsha. shishsha — nechlakin, ad asara. vaasara — en nechelakin, ad esrim.
Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu — hare ellu mitztarfin lezimmun, veim lav — ellu mezammenin leatzman veillu mezammenin leatzman.
En mevarchin al hayyayin ad sheyyitten letocho mayim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: mevarchin.
Gemara may ka mashma lan? tenena chada zimna, shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyayvin lezammen!
Ha ka mashma lan, ki ha deamar rabbi abba amar shemuel: shelosha sheyyashvu leechol keachat, vaadayin lo achlu — enan rashshain lechalek.

Lishshana acharina: amar rabbi abba amar shemuel, hachi katane: shelosha sheyyashvu leechol keachat, af al pi shekkol echad veechad ochel mikkikkaro, enan rashshain lechalek. i name ki ha derav huna, deamar rav huna: shelosha shebbau mishshalosh chavurot, enan rashshain lechalek.
Amar rav chisda: vehu shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha bene adam.
Amar rava:
b: Vela amaran ella dela akdimu hanach veazmun alayyhu beduchetayyhu, aval azmun alayyhu beduchetayyhu — perach zimmun minnayyhu.
Amar rava: mena amena la — ditnan: mitta shennigneva chetzyah, o sheavda chetzyah, o shechalakuha achin o shuttafin — tehora. hecheziruha — mekabbelet tumea mikkan ulehabba.
Mikkan ulehabba — in, lemafrea — la. alma, kevan defalguha — perach la tumea minna. hacha name kevan deazmun alayyhu, perach zimmun minnayyhu.
Shete chavurot vechulei. tana: im yesh shammash benehem — shammash metzarfan.

En mevarchin al hayyayin. tanu rabbanan: yayin ad shello natan letocho mayim — en mevarchin alav "bore peri haggefen" ella "bore peri haetz". venotlin mimmennu layyadayim. mishshennatan letocho mayim — mevarchin alav "bore peri haggefen", veen notlin mimmennu layyadayim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach, mevarchin alav "bore peri haggefen" veen notlin hemennu layyadayim.
Keman azla ha deamar shemuel: ose adam kol tzerachav befat, keman? kerabbi eliezer.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bechos shel beracha sheen mevarchin alav ad sheyyitten letocho mayim. may tama? amar rav oshaya: baenan mitzva min hammuvechar.
Verabbanan, lemay chaze? amar rabbi zera chaze lekureyayte.
Tanu rabbanan: arbaa devarim neemru befat: en mannichin basar chay al happat. veen maavirin kos male al happat. veen zorkin et happat. veen somchin et hakkeara befat.

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe kerachu rifta bahade hadade, ayyeyti lekammayyhu tamre verimmone. shekal mar zutera petak lekammeh derav ashe dastana. amar leh: la savar la mar leha detanya en zorkin et haochalin? hahi befat tanya. vehatanya: keshem sheen zorkin et happat, kach en zorkin et haochalin! amar leh: vehatanya: af al pi sheen zorkin et happat, aval zorkin et haochalin!
Ella la kashya, ha — bemidde demimmeis, ha — bemidde dela mimmeis.

Tanu rabbanan: mamshichin yayin betzinnorot lifne chatan velifne kalla, vezorkin lifnehem kelayot veegozim bimot hachamma, aval lo bimot haggeshamim. aval lo gelusekaot lo bimot hachamma vela bimot haggeshamim.
Amar rav yehuda: shachach vehichnis ochalin letoch piv belo beracha — mesallekan letzad echad umevarech.
Tanya chada: bolan, vetanya iddach: poltan, vetanya iddach: mesallekan.
La kashya. ha detanya bolan bemashkin. veha detanya poltan bemidde dela mimmeis. veha detanya mesallekan bemidde demimmeis.

a: Bemidde dela mimmeis name, lesallekinhu letzad echad velivarech? targema rav yitzchak kaskesaa kammeh derabbi yose bar avin mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: mishshum shenneemar "yimmale fi tehillatecha".
Beo minneh merav chisda: mi sheachal veshata velo berach, mahu sheyyachazor vivarech? amar lehu: mi sheachal shum verecho nodef, yachzor veyochal shum acher kede sheyyehe recho nodef?!
Amar ravina: hilkach afillu gamar seuddato, yachzor vivarech. detanya: taval veala, omer baaliyyayto "baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hattevila".
Vela hi, hatam — meikkara gavra la chaze, hacha — meikkara gavra chaze, vehoil veiddechi — iddechi.
Tanu rabbanan: isparagos — yafe lallev vetov laenayim, vechol shekken livne meayim. veharagil bo — yafe lechol gufo. vehammishtakker hemennu — kashe lechol gufo.
Middekatane yafe lallev, mikkelal divchamra askinan, vekatane: vechol shekken livne meayim. vehatanya: lelaat — yafe, leramat — kashe!

Ki tanya hahi, bimyushshan. keditnan: kuvnnam yayin sheani toem, shehayyayin kashe livne meayim. amru lo: vahalo meyushshan yafe hu livne meayim! veshatak — asur bechadash, umuttar bimyushshan. shema minna.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim neemru beisparagos: en shotin oto ella keshehu chay umale; mekabbelo beyamin veshotehu bismol; veen mesichin acharav, veen mafsikin bo; veen machazirin oto ella lemi shennatnu lo; verak acharav; veen somchin oto ella bemino.
Vehatanya en somchin oto ella befat! la kashya, ha — bidchamra, ha — bidshichra.
Tane chada lelaat yafe, leramat kashe. vetanya iddach: leramat yafe, lelaat kashe! la kashya, ha — bidchamra, ha — bidshichra.
Tane chada: rak acharav — loke. vetanya iddach: lo rak acharav — loke! la kashya, ha — bidchamra, ha — bidshichra.
Amar rav ashe: hasheta deamrat lo rak acharav loke, memav nizrakin afillu bifne hammelech.

Amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha: shelosha devarim sach li suriel sar happanim: al tittol chalukecha beshacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash. veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav. veal tachazir kos isparagos ella lemi shennetano lecha — mippene shettachsefit, veamri la, istalganit shel malache chabbala metzappin lo laadam, veomrim: ematay yavo adam lide echad middevarim hallalu veyillached.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, shelosha devarim sach li malach hammavet: al tittol chalukecha shacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash. veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav. veal taamod lifne hannashim beshaa shechozrot min hammet, mippene sheani merakked uva lifnehen vecharbi beyaday veyesh li reshut lechabbel.

Vei paga, may takkanteh? linshof midducheteh arba ammot, i ikka nahara — lebereh, vei ikka darka acharina — lezil ba, vei ikka guda — leku achora, vei la — layhdar appeh velema: "vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar Adonai becha vegomer" ad dechalfi minneh.

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: asara devarim neemru bechos shel beracha: taun haddacha ushetifa. chay umale. ittur veittuf. notlo bishte yadav, venotno bayyamin. umagbiho min hakkarka tefach, venoten enav bo. veyesh omrim: af meshaggero bemattana leanshe veto.
Amar rabbi yochanan: anu en lanu ella arbaa bilvad: hadacha, shetifa, chay, umale. tana: hadacha — mibbifnim, ushetifa — mibbachutz.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol hamevarech al kos male — notnin lo nachala beli metzarim, shenneemar: "umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha". rabbi yose bar chanina omer: zoche venochel shene olamim, haolam hazze vehaolam habba.
Ittur. rav yehuda meatterehu betalmidim, rav chisda meattar leh benatle. amar rabbi chanan: uvechay. amar rav sheshet: uvevirkat haaretz.
Ittuf. rav pappa miattaf veyatev. rav assi pares sudara al resheh.
Notlo bishte yadav. amar rabbi chinnana bar pappa: may keraa? — "seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et Adonai".
Venotno layyamin. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: rishonim shaalu: semol mahu shettesayyea layyamin? amar rav ashe: hoil verishonim ibbaya lehu velo ippeshit lehu,
b: Anan naaved lechumera.
Umagbiho min hakkarka tefach. amar rav acha berabbi chanina: may keraa — "kos yeshuot essa uveshem Adonai ekra".
Venoten enav bo — ki hechi dela nayssach dateh minneh.
Umeshaggero leanshe beto bemattana — ki hechi detitbarach devethu.

Ulla ikkela leve rav nachman. kerech rifta, barech birkat mezona, yehav leh kasa devirketa lerav nachman. amar leh rav nachman: lishaddar mar kasa devirketa leyalta. amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: en peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish, shenneemar "uverach peri vitnecha". "peri vitnah" lo neemar, ella "peri vitnecha".
Tanya name hachi, rabbi natan omer: minnayin sheen peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish — shenneemar: "uverach peri vitnecha", "peri vitnah" lo neemar, ella "peri vitnecha".

Addehachi shemaa yalta, kama bezihara, veallat leve chamra, utevara arba mea danne dechamra. amar leh rav nachman: neshaddar la mar kasa acharina, shelach la: kol hay navga, devirketa hi. shelacha leh: mimmehaddure — mille, umissemartute — kalme.

Amar rav assi: en massichin al kos shel beracha. veamar rav assi: en mevarchin al kos shel pureanut. may "kos shel pureanut"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kos sheni. tanya name hachi: hashshote kiflayim lo yevarech, mishshum shenneemar "hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael", vehay la metakkan.

Amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: haochel umehallech mevarech meummad, ucheshehu ochel meummad — mevarech meyushshav, ucheshehu mesev veochel — yoshev umevarech. vehilcheta bechullehu yoshev umevarech.
Haderan alach shelosha sheachlu

Mishna ellu devarim shebben bet shammay uven bet hillel basseuda: bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom, veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom.
Bet shammay omrim: notlin layyadayim veachar kach mozgin et hakkos. uvet hillel omrim: mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim.
Bet shammay omrim: mekanneach yadav bammappa, umannichah al hashshulechan. uvet hillel omrim: al hakkeset.
Bet shammay omrim: mechabbedin et habbayit, veachar kach notlin layyadayim. uvet hillel omrim: notlin layyadayim, veachar kach mechabbedin et habbayit.
Bet shammay omrim: ner umazon, besamim vehavedala. uvet hillel omrim: ner uvesamim, mazon vehavedala.
Bet shammay omrim: "shebbara meor haesh", uvet hillel omrim: "bore meore haesh".
En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel goyim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim, velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel avoda zara. veen mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro.
Mi sheachal, veshachach velo berach. bet shammay omrim: yachzor limkomo vivarech. uvet hillel omrim: yevarech bimkom shennizkar. vead matay mevarech? — ad kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav.

Ba lahen yayin achar hammazon, im en sham ella oto kos, bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon. uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin.
Veonin "amen" achar yisrael hamevarech, veen onin "amen" achar kuti hamevarech, ad sheyyishma kol habberacha kullah.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel bisuda. bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. shehayyom gorem layyayin sheyyavo, uchevar kadash hayyom vaadayin yayin lo ba.

Uvet hillel omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom. shehayyayin gorem lakkedushsha shetteamer. davar acher: birkat hayyayin tedira, uvirkat hayyom enah tedira. tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem. vahalacha kedivre bet hillel.
May "davar acher"? vechi tema hatam tarte vehacha chada, hacha name tarte ninhu: birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira, tadir vesheeno tadir — tadir kodem.
Vahalacha kedivre bet hillel. peshita, deha nafka bat kol?
Ibbaet ema kodem bat kol. veibbaet ema leachar bat kol,

a: Verabbi yehoshua hi, deamar: en mashgichin bevat kol.

Vesavri bet shammay devirkat hayyom adifa? vehatanya: hannichnas leveto bemotzae shabbat, mevarech al hayyayin veal hammaor veal habbesamim, veachar kach omer havedala. veim en lo ella kos echad, mannicho leachar hammazon umeshalshelan kullan leacharav.
Veha, mimmay devet shammay hi? dilma bet hillel hi?!

La salka datach, dekatane maor veachar kach besamim, uman shamat leh deit leh hay sevara — bet shammay, detanya amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammazon shebbitchilla veal havedala shehi bassof, al ma nechleku — al hammaor veal habbesamim. bet shammay omrim: maor veachar kach besamim, uvet hillel omrim: besamim veachar kach maor.
Umimmay devet shammay hi veallibba derabbi yehuda, dilma bet hillel hi veallibba derabbi meir?!

La salka datach, dekatane hacha bematnitin, bet shammay omrim: ner umazon besamim vehavedala, uvet hillel omrim: ner uvesamim mazon vehavedala, vehatam bevarayyta katane im en lo ella kos echad, mannicho leachar hammazon, umeshalshelan kullan leacharav. shema minna devet shammay hi veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Umikkol makom kashya. ka savri bet shammay shane ayyole yoma meappoke yoma. ayyole yoma, kamma demakdeminan leh adif. appoke yoma, kamma dimacharinan leh adif, ki hechi dela leheve alan kemassoy.

Vesavri bet shammay birkat hammazon teuna kos? veha tenan: ba lahem yayin leachar hammazon, im en sham ella oto kos, bet shammay omrim: mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon, may lav dimvarech illaveh veshate leh? la, dimvarech illaveh umannach leh.
Vehaamar mar hamevarech tzarich sheyyitom! — detaem leh. vehaamar mar teamo pegamo! — detaem leh bideh.
Vehaamar mar kos shel beracha tzarich shiur, veha ka pachet leh mishshiureh! — dinfish leh tefe mishshiureh.
Veha im en sham ella oto kos katane! — tere la have umechad nefish.
Veha tane rabbi chiyyay: bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyayin veshotehu veachar kach mevarech birkat hammazon! ella tere tannae, veallibba devet shammay.
Bet shammay omrim vechulei.

Tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: notlin layyadayim veachar kach mozgin et hakkos, sheim atta omer mozgin et hakkos techilla, gezera shemma yittamu mashkin sheachore hakkos mechamat yadav, veyachzeru vitammeu et hakkos.
Velittammu yadayim lechos!
Yadayim sheniyyot hen, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin ella al yede mashkin.

Uvet hillel omrim: mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim. sheim atta omer notlin layyadayim techilla, gezera shemma yittamu mashkin shebbayyadayim mechamat hakkos, veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim.
Venittamme kos leyadayim! — en keli metamme adam.
Venittamme lemashkin shebbetocho! — hacha bichli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin askinan, detocho tahor vegabbo tame. ditnan: keli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin achorav temeim
b: Tocho veogno veozno veyadav tehorin. nitma tocho — nitma kullo.
Bemay ka mippalgi?
Bet shammay savri asur lehishtammesh bichli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin, gezera mishshum nitzotzot. velekka lemigzar shemma yittamu hammashkin shebbayyadayim bakkos.
Uvet hillel savri muttar lehishtammesh bichli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin, amri nitzotzot la shechichi, veikka lemechash shemma yittamu mashkin shebbayyadayim mechamat hakkos.
Davar acher: techef lintilat yadayim seuda.

May "davar acher"? hachi kaamri lehu bet hillel levet shammay: ledidchu deamritu asur lehishtammesh bichli sheachorav temein degazrinan mishshum nitzotzot, afillu hachi ha adifa, detechef lintilat yadayim seuda.
Bet shammay omrim mekanneach vechulei.

Tanu rabbanan: bet shammay omrim: mekanneach yadav bammappa umannichah al hashshulchan. sheim atta omer al hakkeset, gezera shemma yittamu mashkin shebbammappa mechamat hakkeset, veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim.
Unetammeyay keset lemappa! — en keli metamme keli.
Unetammeyeh keset legavra gufeh! — en keli metamme adam.
Uvet hillel omrim: al hakkeset. sheim atta omer al hashshulchan, gezera shemma yittamu mashkin shebbammappa mechamat hashshulechan veyachzeru vitammeu et haochalin.
Uletamme shulchan laochalin shebbetocho! — hacha beshulchan sheni askinan, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin ella al yede mashkin.
Bemay kamippalgi? bet shammay savri asur lehishtammesh beshulchan sheni, gezera mishshum ochle teruma.
Uvet hillel savri muttar lehishtammesh beshulchan sheni, ochle teruma zerizin hem.
Davar acher: en netilat yadayim lechullin min hattora.

May "davar acher"? hachi kaamri lehu bet hillel levet shammay: vechi temru may shena gabbe ochalin dechayyshinan umay shena gabbe yadayim dela chayyshinan? afillu hachi ha adifa, deen netilat yadayim lechullin min hattora. mutav sheyyittamu yadayim delet lehu ikkar middeorayyta, veal yittamu ochlim deit lehu ikkar middeorayyta.
Bet shammay omrim mechabbedin vechulei.

Tanu rabbanan: bet shammay omrim mechabbedin et habbayit veachar kach notlin layyadayim, sheim atta omer notlin layyadayim techilla, nimtza atta mafsid et haochalin. aval netilat yadayim levet shammay techilla la sevira lehu. may tama? — mishshum perurin.
Uvet hillel omrim: im shammash talmid chacham hu, notel perurin sheyyesh bahem kezayit, umanniach perurin sheen bahen kezayit.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: perurin sheen bahem kezayit — muttar leabbedan bayyad.
Bemay kamippalgi? bet hillel savri asur lehishtammesh beshammash am haaretz. uvet shammay savri muttar lehishtammesh beshammash am haaretz.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina amar rav huna: bechulleh pirkin halacha kevet hillel, bar meha dahalacha kevet shammay, verabbi oshaya matni ippecha, uveha name halacha kevet hillel.
Bet shammay omrim: ner umazon vechulei.

Rav huna bar yehuda ikkela leve rava. chazyeh lerava devarech abbesamim beresha. amar leh: mikkedi bet shammay uvet hillel ammaor la peligi, detanya bet shammay omrim: ner umazon, besamim vehavedala. uvet hillel omrim: ner uvesamim, mazon vehavedala!

Ane rava batreh: zo divre rabbi meir, aval rabbi yehuda omer lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hammazon shehu battechilla veal havedala shehi bassof, al ma nechleku — al hammaor veal habbesamim, shebbet shammay omrim al hammaor veachar kach besamim, uvet hillel omrim besamim veachar kach maor.
Veamar rabbi yochanan nahagu haam kevet hillel allibba derabbi yehuda.
Bet shammay omrim shebbara kulei.
Amar rava: bevara" kulle alma la peligi devara mashma. ki peligi bevore", bet shammay savri "bore" daatid lemivra, uvet hillel savri "bore" name divra mashma.

Metiv rav yosef: "yotzer or uvore choshech", "yotzer harim uvore ruach", "bore hashshamayim venotehem". ella amar rav yosef: bevara" uvore" kulle alma la peligi devara mashma, ki peligi bimor" umeore". devet shammay savri chada nehora ikka benura, uvet hillel savri tuva nehore ikka benura. tanya name hachi, amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: harebe meorot yesh baor.
En mevarchin kulei. bishlama ner mishshum delo shavat, ella besamim ma taam lo?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hacha bimsibbat goyim askinan, mippene shessetam mesibbat goyim laavoda zara hi.
Ha middekatane sefa en mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel avoda zara, michlal deresha lav baavoda zara askinan!
Amar rabbi chanina missura: "ma taam" kaamar: ma taam en mevarchin al hanner velo al habbesamim shel goyim — mippene shessetam mesibbat goyim laavoda zara.
Tanu rabbanan: ur sheshshavat — mevarchin alav, veshello shavat — en mevarchin alav. may "shavat" umay "lo shavat"?

a: I nema lo shavat mechamat melacha afillu mimmelacha dehettera, vehatanya: ur shel chayya veshel chole — mevarchin alav!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may "shavat" — sheshshavat mechamat melechet avera. tanya name hachi: ashashit shehayta doleket veholechet kol hayyom kullo, lemotzae shabbat mevarchin aleha.
Tanu rabbanan: goy shehidlik miyyisrael, veyisrael shehidlik miggoy mevarchin alav. goy miggoy — en mevarchin alav.
May shena goy miggoy dela — mishshum delo shavat? i hachi, yisrael miggoy name ha lo shavat!

Vechi tema hach issura azal leh, veha acharina hu, uvida deyisrael ka mityalda — ella ha detanya: hammotzi shalhevet lirshut harabbim — chayyayv. ammay chayyayv? ma sheakar lo hinniach, uma shehinniach lo akar!
Ella leolam deissura name iteh, vechi ka mevarech — attosefta dehettera ka mevarech, i hachi, goy miggoy name!
En hachi name, gezera mishshum goy rishon veammud rishon.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa ur, im rov goyim — eno mevarech, im rov yisrael — mevarech.
Ha gufa kashya, amrat im rov goyim — eno mevarech, ha mechetza al mechetza — mevarech, vahadar tane im rov yisrael — mevarech, ha mechetza al mechetza — eno mevarech!
Bedin hu daafillu mechetza al mechetza name mevarech, veayyeydi ditna resha "rov goyim", tena sefa "rov yisrael".
Tanu rabbanan: haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa tinok vaavuka beyado, bodek acharav; im yisrael hu — mevarech, im nachri hu — eno mevarech.
May irya tinok? afillu gadol name!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hacha besamuch lishkiat hachamma askinan. gadol, mochcha milleta devadday nachri hu. tinok, emar yisrael hu, ikkeri uneket.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa ur, im ave kefi hakkivshan — mevarech alav. veim lav eno mevarech alav.
Tane chada: ur shel kivshan mevarchin alav, vetanya iddach: en mevarchin alav!
La kashya: ha battechilla, ha levassof.
Tane chada: ur shel tannur veshel kirayim mevarchin alav, vetanya iddach: en mevarchin alav!
La kashya: ha battechilla, ha levassof.
Tane chada: ur shel bet hakkeneset veshel bet hammidrash mevarchin alav, vetanya iddach: en mevarchin alav!
La kashya: ha deikka adam chashuv, ha delekka adam chashuv.
Vei baet ema ha veha deikka adam chashuv, vela kashya: ha deikka chazzana, ha delekka chazzana.
Vei baet ema ha veha deikka chazzana, vela kashya: ha deikka sehara, veha delekka sehara.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu yoshvin bevet hammidrash veheviu ur lifnehem, bet shammay omrim: kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. uvet hillel omrim: echad mevarech lechullan — mishshum shenneemar: "berov am haderat melech".
Bishlama bet hillel mefarshi tama, ella bet shammay may tama? kasavri mippene bittul bet hammidrash.
Tanya name hachi: shel bet rabban gamliel lo hayu omrim "marpe" bevet hammidrash, mippene bittul bet hammidrash.
En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim. may tama? ner — lechavod hu daavida, besamim leabbore recha hu daavidi.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol shemmotziin lefanav bayyom uvallayla — en mevarchin alav. vechol sheen motziin lefanav ella ballayla — mevarchin alav.
Amar rav huna: besamim shel bet hakkisse, veshemen heasuy lehaavir et hazzuhama — en mevarchin alav.

Lememra dechol hecha delav lerecha avida la mevarchin illaveh? metivi: hannichnas lachanuto shel bassam veheriach reach, afillu yashav sham kol hayyom kullo eno mevarech ella paam achat. nichnas veyatza, nichnas veyatza — mevarech al kol paam ufaam. veha hacha delav lerecha hu daavida, vekamvarech!
In, lerecha name hu daavida, ki hechi denerchu inashe venetu venizbon minneh.

Tanu rabbanan: haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veheriach reach, im rov goyim — eno mevarech, im rov yisrael — mevarech. rabbi yose omer: afillu rov yisrael — name eno mevarech, mippene shebbenot yisrael mekatterot lichshafim.
Attu kullehu lichshafim mekatteran?! — have la miuta lichshafim, umiuta name legammer et hakkelim. ishtechach rubba delav lerecha avid, vechol rubba delav lerecha avid la mevarech.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hamehallech bearve shabbatot bitverya uvemotzae shabbatot betzippori veheriach reach, eno mevarech, mippene shechezkato eno asuy ella legammer bo et hakkelim.
Tanu rabbanan: haya mehallech bashshuk shel avoda zara nitratztza lehariach — hare ze chote.
b: Veen mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo "yeotu" yeotu mammash, ella kol sheillu omed bekarov umishtammesh leorah, vaafillu berichuk makom. vechen amar rav ashe: berichuk makom shaninu.
Metivi: hayta lo ner temuna becheko, o befannas, o sheraa shalhevet velo nishtammesh leorah, o nishtammesh leorah velo raa shalhevet — eno mevarech ad sheyyire shalhevet veyishtammesh leorah.
Bishlama mishtammesh leorah velo raa shalhevet mashkachat la — dekayyma bekeren zavit. ella raa shalhevet velo nishtammesh leorah hechi mashkachat la? lav dimrachaka?!
La, kegon deamya veazla.
Tanu rabbanan: gechalim lochashot — mevarchin alehen, ommot — en mevarchin alehen. hechi dame lochashot? amar rav chisda: kol sheillu machnis letochan kesam vedoleket meeleha.
Ibbaya lehu: "ommot" o "ommot"?
Ta shema deamar rav chisda bar avdimi: "arazim lo amamuhu began elohim".
Verava amar: "yeotu" mammash.
Vechamma? amar ulla: kede sheyyakkir ben issar lefunedyon. chizkiyya amar: kede sheyyakkir ben meluzema shel teverya limluzema shel tzippori.
Rav yehuda mevarech addeve adda dayyayla, rava mevarech addeve gureya bar chama. abbaye mevarech addeve bar avu.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: en mechazzerin al haur kederech shemchazzerim al hammitzvot. amar rabbi zera: meresh hava mehaddarna, kevan dishmana leha derav yehuda amar rav, ana name la mehaddarna, ella i mikkela li mimmela — mevarechna.
Mi sheachal vechulei. amar rav zevid veittema rav dimi bar abba: machaloket beshachach, aval bemezid, divre hakkol — yachzor limkomo vivarech.
Peshita, "veshachach" tenan.
Mahu detema hu haddin afillu bemezid, vehay dekatane "veshachach" — lehodiacha kochan devet shammay. kamashma lan.
