Tanya, amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: ledivrechem, mi sheachal berosh habbira veshachach veyarad velo berach, yachzor lerosh habbira vivarech?! amru lahen bet shammay levet hillel: ledivrechem mi sheshshachach arnaki berosh habbira lo yaale veyitlenna? lichvod atzmo hu ole, lichvod shamayim lo kol shekken?!
Hanhu tere talmide, chad avad beshogeg kevet shammay veashkach arneka dedahava, vechad avad bemezid kevet hillel veachleh arya.

Rabba bar bar chana hava kaazel beshayyayrta, achal veishteli vela barech. amar: hechi aaved? i amena lehu "inneshay levarech", amru li: barech, kol hecha dimvarchat — lerachamana mevarchat. mutav deamena lehu: inneshay yona dedahava. amar lehu: intaru li, deinneshay yona dedahava. azel uvarech veashkach yona dedahava.

Umay shena yona? dimtili keneset yisrael leyona. dichtiv: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz" — ma yona enah nitztzolet ella bichnafeha, af yisrael enan nitztzolin ella bemitzvot.
Ad ematay hu vechulei.
Kamma shiur ikkul? amar rabbi yochanan: kol zeman sheeno raev. veresh lakish amar: kol zeman sheyyitzma mechamat achilato.

Amar leh rav yemar bar shelemya lemar zutera veamri la rav yemar bar shezvi lemar zutera: mi amar resh lakish hachi? vehaamar rav amme amar resh lakish: kamma shiur ikkul? — kede lehallech arba milin!
La kashya: kan baachila merubba, kan baachila muetet.
Ba lahen yayin vechulei.
Lememra deyisrael af al gav dela shama kullah beracha one? vechi la shama hechi nafek?

Amar chiyyay bar rav: beshello achal immahen, vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu beshello achal immahen. amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh: beri, chatof uvarech. vechen amar rav huna lerabba bereh: chatof uvarech.
Lememra dimvarech adif mimman deane "amen"? vehatanya rabbi yose omer: gadol haone "amen" yoter min hamevarech.
Amar leh rabbi nehoray: hashshamayim, ken hu. tidda — shehare guleyayrin yordin umitgarin bammilchama, vegibborim yordin umenatztzechin!
Tannae hi. detanya: echad hamevarech veechad haone "amen" bammashma, ella shemmemaharin lamvarech yoter min haone amen.

Bea minneh shemuel merav: mahu laanot "amen" achar tinokot shel bet rabban? amar leh: achar hakkol onin amen, chutz mittinokot shel bet rabban, hoil ulehitlammed asuyin. vehane mille bidla iddan mifterayyhu, aval beiddan mifterayyhu — onin.

Tanu rabbanan: shemen meakkev et habberacha, divre rabbi zilay. rabbi zivay omer: eno meakkev. rav acha omer: shemen tov meakkev. rabbi zuhamay omer: keshem shemmezoham pasul laavoda, kach yadayim mezohamot pesulot livracha.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana la zilay vela zivay vela zuhamay yadana ella matnita yadana. deamar rav yehuda amar rav veamri la bematnita tana: "vehitkaddishtem" ellu mayim rishonim, "vihyitem kedoshim" ellu mayim acharonim, "ki kadosh" — ze shemen, "ani Adonai elohechem" — zo beracha.
Haderan alach ellu Devarim

a: Mishna haroe makom shennaasu bo nissim leyisrael, omer: "baruch … sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze". makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara, omer: "baruch … sheakar avoda zara meartzenu".

Al hazzikin, veal hazzevaot, veal haramim, veal haruchot, veal habberakim omer: "baruch … shekkocho ugevurato male olam". al heharim, veal haggevaot, veal hayyammim, veal hanneharot, veal hammidbarot omer: "baruch … ose bereshit". rabbi yehuda, omer: haroe et hayyam haggadol, omer: "baruch sheasa et hayyam haggadol" — bizman sheroehu lifrakim.

Al haggeshamim, veal besorot tovot omer: "baruch hattov vehammetiv". al besorot raot omer: "baruch dayyayn haemet". bana bayit chadash, vekana kelim chadashim, omer: "baruch … shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". mevarech al haraa meen al hattova, veal hattova meen al haraa.

Vehatztzoek lesheavar — hare zo tefillat shav. hayta ishto meubberet, veomer: "yehi ratzon shetteled ishti zachar" — hare zo tefillat shav. haya ba badderech veshama kol tzevacha bair, veomer: "yehi ratzon shello tehe betoch beti" — hare zo tefillat shav.
Hannichnas lichrach mitpallel shetayim, achat bichnisato, veachat bitziato. ben azzay omer: arba, shetayim bichnisato, ushetayim bitziato. noten hodaa al sheavar vetzoek al heatid.

Chayyayv adam levarech al haraa keshem shemmevarech al hattova, shenneemar: "veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha vegomer". "bechol levavcha" — bishne yetzarecha, beyetzer tov uveyetzer hara. "uvechol nafshecha" — afillu hu notel et nafshecha. "uvechol meodecha" — bechol mamoncha. davar acher: "bechol meodecha" — bechol midda umidda shehu moded lecha heve mode lo.

Lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim. velo yikkanes lehar habbayit bemaklo, uveminalo, uvefunedato, uveavak sheal raglav. vela yaasennu kappandarya. urekika — mikkal vachomer.
Kol chotme berachot shebbammikdash hayu omrim "ad haolam". mishshekkilkelu hamminin veamru en olam ella echad, hitkinu sheyyehu omrim "min haolam vead haolam".

Vehitkinu sheyyehe adam shoel et shelom chavero bashshem, shenneemar: "vehinne voaz ba mibbet lechem vayyomer lakkotzrim Adonai immachem vayyomru lo yevarechcha Adonai". veomer: "Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil". veomer: "al tavuz ki zakna immecha". veomer: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha". rabbi natan omer: "heferu toratecha" mishshum "et laasot laAdonai".
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vayyomer yitro baruch Adonai asher hitztzil vegomer".

Annissa derabbim mevarchinan, annissa deyachid la mevarchinan?! veha hahu gavra dahava ka azel baavar yammina. nefal aleh arya, itavid leh nissa veittatztzal minneh. ata lekammeh derava, vaamar leh: kol immat dematet lehatam — barech "baruch sheasa li nes bammakom hazze".
Umar bereh deravina hava kaazel befakta daaravot utzecha lemayya. itavid leh nissa, ibberi leh ena demayya, veishti.

Vetu, zimna chada hava kaazel berasteka demachoza unefal aleh gamla peritza. itparaka leh ashita, al legavva. ki meta laaravot barech: "baruch … sheasa li nes baaravot uvegamal". ki meta lerasteka demachoza barech: "baruch … sheasa li nes begamal uvaaravot"! amri: annissa derabbim — kulle alma michayyeyvi levaroche, annissa deyachid — ihu chayyayv levaroche.

Tanu rabbanan: haroe maberot hayyam, umaberot hayyarden, maberot nachale arnon, avne elgavish bemorad bet choron, veeven shebbikkesh lizrok og melech habbashan al yisrael, veeven sheyyashav aleha moshe beshaa sheasa yehoshua milchama baamalek, veishto shel lot, vechomat yericho shennivlea bimkomah — al kullan tzarich sheyyitten hodaa vashevach lifne hammakom.

Bishlama maberot hayyam, dichtiv: "vayyavou vene yisrael betoch hayyam bayyabbasha". maberot hayyarden, dichtiv: "vayyaamdu hakkohanim nose haaron berit Adonai becharava betoch hayyarden hachen vechol yisrael ovrim becharava ad asher tammu kol haggoy laavor et hayyarden".

Ella maberot nachale arnon menalan? — dichtiv: "al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa vegomer". tana: "et vahev besufa" — shene metzoraim hayu, dahavo mehallechin besof machane yisrael. ki havo ka chalfi yisrael ato emorae
b: Avdi lehon nekirata utesho behon. amri: ki chalfi yisrael hacha — niktelinnun, vela havo yadi dearon hava mesagge kammayyhu deyisrael vahava mammech lehu ture mikkammayyhu. kevan daata aron, iddevaku ture bahade hadade, vekatlinnun, unechat demayyhu lenachale arnon. ki ato et vahev, chazo dema deka nafek mibbene ture. ato veamri lehu leyisrael vaamaru shira. hayeynu dichtiv: "veeshed hannechalim asher nata leshevet ar venishan ligvul moav".
Avne elgavish. may avne elgavish?

Tana: avanim sheamdu al gav ish, veyardu al gav ish. amdu al gav ish — ze moshe, dichtiv: "vehaish moshe anav meod", uchetiv: "vayyachdelu hakkolot vehabbarad umatar lo nittach artza". yardu al gav ish — ze yehoshua, dichtiv: "kach lecha et yehoshua bin nun ish asher ruach bo", uchetiv: "vayhi benusam mippene bene yisrael hem bemorad bet choron vaAdonai hishlich alehem avanim gedolot".

Even shebbikkesh og melech habbashan lizrok al yisrael, gemara gemiri la. amar machane yisrael kamma have — telata parse, ezel veeekar tura bar telata parse veishde alayyhu, veiktelinhu. azal akar tura bar telata parse veayyti al resheh, veayyti kudesha berich hu aleh kamtze venakvu, unechet betzavvereh.

Hava bae lemishlefe, mashchi shinneh lehay gisa ulehay gisa vela matze lemishlefe. vehayeynu dichtiv: "shinne reshaim shibbarta". vechidrabbi shimon ben lakish. deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv "shinne reshaim shibbarta" — al tikre "shibbarta" ella "shirbavta".
Moshe kamma hava — eser ammot, shekel narga bar asar ammin, shevavr asar ammin, umachyeh bekarsulleh vekatleh.
Veeven sheyyashav aleha moshe — dichtiv: "vide moshe kevedim vayyikchu even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha".
Veishto shel lot — shenneemar: "vattabbet ishto meacharav vattehi netziv melach". vechomat yericho shennivlea — dichtiv: "vattippol hachoma tachteha".
Bishlama kullehu — nissa, ella ishto shel lot pureanuta hu! — deamar "baruch … dayyayn haemet".

Veha "hodaa vashevach" katane! teni: al lot veal ishto mevarchim shetayim. al ishto omer "baruch … dayyayn haemet", veal lot omer "baruch … zocher et hatztzaddikim". amar rabbi yochanan: afillu bishat kaaso shel hakkadosh baruch hu, zocher et hatztzaddikim, shenneemar: "vayhi beshachet elohim et are hakkikkar vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegomer".

Vechomat yericho shennivlea. vechomat yericho nivlea? veha nafla, shenneemar: "vayhi chishmoa haam et kol hashshofar vayyariu haam terua gedola vattippol hachoma tachteha"! — kevan defuteya veruma ki hadade ninhu, mishshum hachi ibbala beloe.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: arbaa tzerichin lehodot: yorde hayyam, holche midbarot, umi shehaya chole venitrappe, umi shehaya chavush bevet haasurim veyatza.

Yorde hayyam menalan? — dichtiv: "yorde hayyam booniyyot vegomer hemma rau maase Adonai". veomer: "vayyaamed ruach seara yaalu shamayim yerdu tehomot", veomer: "yachoggu veyanuu kashshikkor", veomer: "vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem umimmetzukotehem yotziem", veomer: "yakem seara lidmama", veomer: "vayyismechu chi yishtoku", veomer: "yodu laAdonai chasdo venifleotav livne adam".
Holche midbarot menalan? dichtiv: "tau vammidbar bishimon darech ir moshav lo matzau … vayyitzaku el Adonai … vayyadrichem bederech yeshara … yodu laAdonai chasdo".

Mi shechala venitrappe, dichtiv: "evilim midderech pisham umeavonotehem yitannu. kol ochel tetaev nafsham vegomer vayyizaku el Adonai batztzar lahem vegomer yishlach devaro veyirpaem vegomer yodu laAdonai chasdo".

Mi shehaya chavush bevet haasurin menalan? — dichtiv: "yoshve choshech vetzalmavet vegomer ki himru imre el vegomer". veomer: "vayyachna beamal libbam vegomer", veomer: "vayyizaku el Adonai batztzar lahem", veomer: "yotziem mechoshech vetzalmavet vegomer", veomer: "yodu laAdonai chasdo".

May mevarech? amar rav yehuda: "baruch gomel chasadim tovim". abbaye amar: vetzarich leodoye kamme asra, dichtiv: "virommuhu bikhal am vegomer". mar zutera amar: uteren minnayyhu rabbanan, shenneemar: "uvemoshav zekenim yehalluhu".
Matkef la rav ashe: veema kullehu rabbanan?! — mi ketiv "bikhal zekenim"? "bikhal am" ketiv. veema be asra shear amma, utere rabbanan! kashya.
Rav yehuda chalash veittefach. al legabbeh rav chana bagdataa verabbanan. amri leh: "berich rachamana deyahavach nihalan vela yahavach leafra". amar lehu: petartun yati milleodoye.
Veha amar abbaye bae odoye beappe asra! — dahavo be asra. veha ihu la ka mode! — la tzerich, deane batrayyhu "amen".
Amar rav yehuda: shelosha tzerichin shimmur, veellu hen — chole, chatan, vechalla. bematnita tana: chole, chayya, chatan, vechalla. veyesh omrim: af avel. veyesh omrim: af talmide chachamim ballayla.
Veamar rav yehuda: shelosha devarim hammaarich bahen maarichin yamav ushenotav shel adam. hammaarich bitfillato, vehammaarich al shulchano, vehammaarich bevet hakkisse.
Vehammaarich bitfillato mealleyuta hi? vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Kol hammaarich bitfillato umeayyen bah — sof ba lide keev lev, shenneemar: "tochelet memushshacha machala lev". veamar rabbi yitzchak: shelosha devarim mazkirim avonotav shel adam, veellu hen: kir natuy, veiyyun tefilla, umoser din al chavero lashshamayim!
Ha la kashya: ha dimayyen ba, ha dela meayyen ba. vehechi aved? — demappesh berachame.

Vehammaarich al shulchano: dilma ate anya veyahev leh. dichtiv: "hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoah", uchetiv: "vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai", patach bemizbeach vesiyyem beshulchan! rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: kol zeman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — mizbeach mechapper al yisrael, veachshav, shulchano shel adam mechapper alav.

Vehammaarich bevet hakkisse: mealleyuta hu? vehatanya: asara devarim meviin et haadam lide tachtoniyyot: haochel ale kanim, vaale gefanim, velulabbe gefanim, umorigge vehema, veshidro shel dag, vedag maliach sheeno mevushshal kol tzarko, vehashshote shimre yayin, vehamekanneach besid uvecharsit. vehamekanneach bitzror shekkinnach bo chavero, veyesh omrim: af hattole atzmo bevet hakkisse yoter midday.
La kashya: ha demaarich vetale, ha demaarich vela tale.

Ki ha daamara leh hahi matronita lerabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: panecha domim limgaddele chazirim ulemalve beribbit. amar la: hemanuta, ledidi tarvayyhu asiran, ella — esrim vearbaa bet hakkisse ikka meushepizay leve midresha, dechi azelna, badekna nafshay bechullehu.
Veamar rav yehuda: shelosha devarim mekatztzerim yamav ushenotav shel adam: mi shennotnin lo sefer tora likrot veeno kore, kos shel beracha levarech veeno mevarech, vehammanhig atzmo berabbanut.

Sefer tora likrot veeno kore, dichtiv: "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha". kos shel beracha levarech veeno mevarech — dichtiv: "vaavarcha mevarchecha". vehammanhig atzmo berabbanut — deamar rabbi chama bar chanina: mippene ma met yosef kodem leechav — mippene shehinhig atzmo berabbanut.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav, shelosha tzerichim rachamim: melech tov, shana tova vachalom tov. melech tov — dichtiv: "palge mayim lev melech beyad Adonai". shana tova — dichtiv: "tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana". chalom tov — dichtiv: "vetachalimeni vetachayeni".

Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha devarim machriz alehem hakkadosh baruch hu beatzmo veellu hen: raav, vesova, ufarnas tov. raav — dichtiv: "ki kara Adonai laraav vegomer". sova — dichtiv: "vekarati el haddagan vehirbeti oto". parnas tov — dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe lemor. ree karati veshem betzalel vegomer".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: en maamidin parnas al hatztzibbur ella im ken nimlachim batztzibbur, shenneemar: "reu kara Adonai beshem betzalel", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe, hagun alecha betzalel? amar lo: ribbono shel olam, im lefanecha hagun — lefanay lo kol shekken! amar lo: af al pi chen, lech emor lahem. halach veamar lahem leyisrael: hagun alechem betzalel? amru lo: im lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ulefanecha hu hagun, lefanenu lo kol shekken!

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: betzalel al shem chochmato nikra. beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: lech emor lo livtzalel "ase li mishkan aron vechelim". halach moshe vehafach veamar lo: "ase aron vechelim umishkan". amar lo: moshe rabbenu, minhago shel olam adam bone bayit veachar kach machnis letocho kelim, veatta omer "ase li aron vechelim umishkan", kelim sheani ose, lehechan achnisem? shemma kach amar lecha hakkadosh baruch hu, "ase mishkan aron vechelim"?! amar lo: shemma betzel el hayita veyadata?

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yodea haya betzalel letzaref otiyyot shennivreu bahen shamayim vaaretz. ketiv hacha: "vaymalle oto ruach elohim bechochma uvitvuna uvedaat", uchetiv hatam: "Adonai bechochma yasad aretz konen shamayim bitvuna". uchetiv: "bedato tehomot nivkau".

Amar rabbi yochanan: en hakkadosh baruch hu noten chachma ella lemi sheyyesh bo chachma, shenneemar: "yahev chochmeta lechakkimin umandea leyade vina". shema rav tachlifa bar mareva veamra kammeh derabbi avahu. amar leh: attun mehatam matnitu la, anan mehacha matninan la, dichtiv: "uvelev kol chacham lev natatti chochma".

Amar rav chisda: kol chalom, vela tevot. veamar rav chisda: chelma dela mefashshar keiggarta dela mikkarya. veamar rav chisda: la chelma tava mikkayyaym kulleh vela chelma bisha mikkayyaym kulleh. veamar rav chisda: chelma bisha adif mechelma tava. veamar rav chisda: chelma bisha — atzivuteh misteyeh, chelma tava — chedveh misteyeh. amar rav yosef: chelma tava, afillu ledidi, bedichuteh mefakkecha leh. veamar rav chisda: chelma bisha kashe minnegada, shenneemar: "vehaelohim asa sheyyiru millefanav", veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ze chalom ra.

"Hannavi asher itto chalom yesapper chalom vaasher devari itto yedabber devari emet ma latteven et habbar neum Adonai". vechi ma inyan bar veteven etzel chalom? ella amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: keshem shei efshar levar belo teven, kach i efshar lachalom belo devarim betelim.
Amar rabbi berechya: chalom, af al pi shemmiktzato mitkayyem — kullo eno mitkayyem. mena lan? — miyyosef, dichtiv: "vehinne hashshemesh vehayyareach vegomer".
b: Vehahi shata immeh la havat.

Amar rabbi levi: leolam yetzappe adam lachalom tov ad esrim ushetayim shana. menalan? — miyyosef, dichtiv: "elle toldot yaakov yosef ben sheva esre shana vegomer", uchetiv: "veyosef ben sheloshim shana beomdo lifne paro vegomer". min shavsere ad telatin kamma have? — telat sere, veshav desiva vetarte dechafna — ha esrim ushetayim.
Amar rav huna: leadam tov en marin lo chalom tov, uleadam ra en marin lo chalom ra.
Tanya name hachi: kol shenotav shel david lo raa chalom tov, vechol shenotav shel achitofel lo raa chalom ra.

Vehachtiv: "lo teunne elecha raa". veamar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba: shello yavhilucha lo chalomot raim velo hirhurim raim. "venega lo yikrav beoholecha" — shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda beshaa sheatta ba min hadderech. ella ihu la chaze leh, acharine chazu leh.

Vechi la chaza ihu, mealleyuta hu? vehaamar rabbi zeera: kol hallan shiva yamim belo chalom — nikra "ra". shenneemar: "vesavea yalin bal yippaked ra". al tikre "savea" ella "sheva". — ella, hachi kaamar: dachaza vela yada may chaza.

Amar rav huna bar amme amar rabbi pedat amar rabbi yochanan: haroe chalom venafsho aguma, yelech veyifterennu bifne shelosha. "yifterennu"?! vehaamar rav chisda chelma dela mefashshar keiggarta dela mikkarya? ella ema: yetivennu bifne shelosha. layte telata velema lehu: "chelma tava chazay". velemru leh hanach: "tava hu vetava leheve, rachamana leshavveyeh letav. sheva zimnin ligzeru alach min shemayya deleheve tava, veyeheve tava". velemru shalosh hafuchot, veshalosh peduyot, veshalosh shelomot.

Shalosh hafuchot — "hafachta mispedi lemachol li pittachta sakki vatteazzereni simcha", "az tismach betula bemachol uvachurim uzekenim yachdav vehafachti evlam lesason vegomer", "velo ava Adonai elohecha lishmoa el bilam vayyahafoch vegomer".
Shalosh peduyot, dichtiv: "pada veshalom nafshi mikkerov li vegomer", "ufeduye Adonai yeshuvun vegomer", "vayyomer haam el shaul hayonatan yamut asher asa hayeshua vegomer".
Shalosh shelomot, dichtiv: "bore niv sefatayim shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar Adonai urefativ", "veruach lavsha et amasay vegomer", "vaamartem ko lechay veatta shalom uvetcha shalom vegomer".

Ammemar umar zutera verav ashe havo yatvi bahade hadade. amri: kol chad vechad minnan lema milleta dela shemia leh lechavreh. petach chad minnayyhu vaamar: hay man dachaza chelma vela yada may chaza, likum kamme kahane beiddana defarsi yedayyhu velema hachi: "ribbono shel olam, ani shellach vachalomotay shellach, chalom chalamti veeni yodea ma hu. ben shechalamti ani leatzmi uven shechalmu li chaveray uven shechalamti al acherim, im tovim hem — chazzekem veammetzem kachalomotav shel yosef. veim tzerichim refua — refaem keme mara al yede moshe rabbenu, uchemiryam mitztzaratah, uchechizkiyya mecholyo, ucheme yericho al yede elisha. ucheshem shehafachta killat bilam harasha livracha, ken hafoch kol chalomotay alay letova". umesayyem bahade kahane deane tzibbura "amen". vei la, lema hachi: "addir bammarom, shochen bigvura, atta shalom veshimcha shalom. yehi ratzon millefanecha shettasim alenu shalom".

Petach iddach vaamar: hay man deayel lemata vedachel meena bisha, linkot zikpa dida deyammineh bida dismaleh vezikpa dida dismaleh bida deyammineh, velema hachi: ana peloni bar peloni mizzara deyosef kaatena, dela shalta beh ena visha, shenneemar: "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin vegomer", al tikre "ale ayin", ella "ole ayin". rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar, mehacha: "veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz" — ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassim alehem veen ayin raa sholetet bahem, af zaro shel yosef en ayin raa sholetet bahem. vei dachel meena bisha dileh, lichze atrefa dinchireh dismaleh.

Petach iddach vaamar: hay man dachalish, yoma kamma la legalle, ki hechi dela littara mazzaleh, mikkan veelach legalle. ki ha derava, ki hava chalish, yoma kamma la megalle mikkan veelach amar leh leshammaeh: pok achrez: "rava chalash". man derachem li — live alay rachame, uman desane li — lichde li. uchetiv: "binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha pen yire Adonai vera beenav veheshiv mealav appo".
Shemuel ki hava chaze chelma bisha amar: "vachalomot hashshav yedabberu". ki hava chaze chelma tava amar: vechi hachalomot hashshav yedabberu? vehachtiv "bachalom adabber bo"!
Rava rame: ketiv "bachalom adabber bo", uchetiv: "vachalomot hashshav yedabberu"! la kashya: kan al yede malach, kan al yede shed.

Amar rabbi bizna bar zavda amar rabbi akiva amar rabbi panda amar rav nachum amar rabbi birim mishshum zaken echad, umannu — rabbi benaa: esrim vearbaa potre chalomot hayu birushalayim, paam achat chalamti chalom vehalachti etzel kullam, uma sheppatar li ze lo patar li ze, vechullam nitkayyeymu bi. lekayyem ma shenneemar: "kol hachalomot holchim achar happe".

Attu "kol hachalomot holchim achar happe" kera hu? in — vechidrabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin shekkol hachalomot holchin achar happe? — shenneemar: "vayhi kaasher patar lanu ken haya". amar rava: vehu dimfashshar leh meen chelmeh, shenneemar "ish kachalomo patar".
"Vayyar sar haofim", mena yeda? amar rabbi elazar: melammed shekkol echad veechad heruhu chalomo ufitron chalomo shel chavero.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hishkim venafal lo pasuk letoch piv, hare zo nevua ketanna.

Veamar rabbi yochanan, shelosha chalomot mitkayyeymin: chalom shel shacharit, vachalom shechalam lo chavero, vachalom shenniftar betoch chalom. veyesh omer: af chalom shennishna, shenneemar: "veal hishshanot hachalom vegomer".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: en marin lo leadam ella mehirhure libbo. shenneemar: "ant malka rayonach al mishkevach seliku". veibbaet ema mehacha: "verayone livvach tinda". amar rava: tidda, dela machavu leh leinish la dikla dedahava vela pila deayel bekofa demachta.

a: Amar leh kesar lerabbi yehoshua berabbi chananya: amritu dechachmitu tuva, ema li may chazena bechelmay. amar leh: chazet dimshachari lach parsae vegarvi bach, veraayi bach shiktze bechutera dedahava. harehar kulleh yoma, uleureta chaza. amar leh shabbur malka, lishmuel: amritu dechachmitu tuva, ema li may chazena bechelmay. amar leh: chazet deatu romae veshavu lach, vetachani bach kashyayta berichyay dedahava. harehar kulleh yoma, uleureta chaza.

Bar hedya mefashshar chelme hava. man deyahev leh agra — mefashshar leh limalleyuta, uman dela yahev leh agra — mefashshar leh ligriuta. abbaye verava chazo chelma. abbaye yehev leh zuza, verava la yehev leh. amri leh: akrinan bechelmin "shorcha tavuach leenecha vegomer". lerava amar leh: pased iskach vela ahani lach lemechal meutzeba delibbach. leabbaye amar leh: marvavch iskach vela ahani lach lemechal mechedva delibbach.
Amri leh: akrinan "banim uvanot tolid vegomer" lerava amar leh: kevishuteh. leabbaye amar leh: benach uvenatach nefishi, uminnasvan benatach lealma, umiddamyayn beappach kidka azlan beshivya.

Akreyuyn "banecha uvenotecha netunim leam acher". leabbaye amar leh: benach uvenatach nefishin, at amrat lekarivach vehi amra lekariva, veachfa lach veyahavat lehon lekariva, dehave keam acher. lerava amar leh: devethu shechiva, veatu beneh uvenateh lide itteta achariti. deamar rava amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: may dichtiv "banecha uvenotecha netunim leam acher" — zo eshet haav.

Akrinan bechelmin: "lech echol besimcha lachmecha". leabbaye amar leh: marvavch iskach veachlat veshatet vekaret pesuka mechedva delibbach. lerava amar leh: pased iskach, tavchat vela achlat veshatet vekaret lefakkoche pachdach.
Akrinan "zera rav totzi hassade". leabbaye amar leh meresheh, lerava amar leh missefeh.
Akrinan "zetim yihyu lecha bechol gevulecha vegomer". leabbaye amar leh meresheh, lerava amar leh missefeh.

Akrinan "verau kol amme haaretz vegomer". leabbaye amar leh: nafek lach shema deresh metivta havet, emtach nefalat bealma. lerava amar leh: bedayyna demalka ittevar, umittefasat begannave, vedayyni kulle alma kal vachomer minnach. limchar ittevar bedayyna demalka vaato vetafsi leh lerava.
Amri leh: chazan chassa al pum danne. leabbaye amar leh: if iskach kechassa. lerava amar leh: marir iskach ki chassa.

Amri leh: chazan bisra al pum danne. leabbaye amar leh: basem chamrach, veatu kulle alma lemizban bisra vechamra minnach. lerava amar leh: takef chamrach, veatu kulle alma lemizban bisra lemechal beh.
Amri leh: chazan chavita ditle bedikla. leabbaye amar leh: middele iskach kedikla. lerava amar leh: chale iskach ketamre.
Amri leh: chazan rummana dekadcha appum danne, leabbaye amar leh: ashik iskach kerummana. lerava amar leh: kave iskach kerummana.
Amri leh: chazan chavita dinfal levera. leabbaye amar leh: mitbee iskach, kidamar "nefal pitta bevera vela ishtechach". lerava amar leh: pased iskach veshadet leh levera.

Amri leh: chazenan bar chamara dekae aisadan venoer. leabbaye amar leh: malka havet, vekae amora alach. lerava amar leh: "peter chamor" gehit mittefillach. amar leh: ledidi chaze li veiteh. amar leh: vav defeter chamor" vadday gehit mittefillach.

Lesof azal rava lechodeh legabbeh. amar leh: chazay dashsha barayyta dinfal. amar leh: ishtecha shachva. amar leh: chazay kakkay veshinnay dintur. amar leh: benach uvenatach shachvan. amar leh: chazay tarte yone defarchan. amar leh: tere neshe megarshat. amar leh: chazay tere gargelide delifta. amar leh: teren kulefe balat. azal rava hahu yoma vitev be midresha kulleh yoma. ashkach hanhu tere saggi nehore dahavo kaminnetzu bahade hadade. azal rava lefarokinhu, umechohu lerava tere. delo lemachoyeh achariti, amar: mistayy, teren chazay.

Lesof ata rava vihev leh agra. amar leh: chazay ashita dinfal. amar leh: nechasim belo metzarim kanet. amar leh: chazay appadna deabbaye dinfal vechasseyayn avkeh. amar leh: abbaye shachev umetivteh atya legabbach. amar leh: chazay appadna didi dinfal, vaato kulle alma shekul leventa leventa. amar leh: shematatach mibbadderan bealma. amar leh: chazay deibbeka reshi unetar mukeri. amar leh: udera mibbe sadya nafek. amar leh: akreyun hallela mitzraa bechelma. amar leh: nisse mitrachshi lach.

Hava ka azel bahadeh bearba. amar: bahade gavra demitrechish leh nissa lema li. bahade deka salek nefal sifra minneh. ashkecheh rava vachaza dahava ketiv beh "kol hachalomot holchin achar happe". amar: rasha, bedidach kayyma, vetzaartan kulle hay. kullehu machelna lach, bar mibberatte derav chisda. yehe raava delimmesar hahu gavra lide demalchuta dela merachamu aleh.
Amar: may aaved? gemiri dekillat chacham, afillu bechinnam hi baa, vechol shekken rava divdina ka layet. amar: ekum veegle, daamar mar: galut mechapperet avon.

Kam geli leve romae. azal yetev appitcha deresh turezina demalka. resh turezina chaza chelma. amar leh: chazay chelma deayel machta beetzbati. amar leh: hav li zuza, vela yehav leh. la amar leh vela midde. amar leh: chazay dinfal tichla betarten etzbeati. amar leh: hav li zuza, vela yehav leh, vela amar leh. amar leh: chazay dinfal tichla bechulla yeda. amar leh: nefal tichla bechullehu shirae. shami be malka, veatyu leresh turezina ka katli leh. amar lehu: ana ammay? ayyto lehay dahava yada vela amar. ayytuhu bar hedya, amri leh: ammattu zuza didach charavu
b: Shirae demalka! kefitu teren arze bechavla, asur chad keraeh lechad arza vechad keraeh lechad arza, ushero lechavla ad deitztelik resheh. azal kol chad vechad vekam adducheteh veitztelik unefal bitren.
Shaal ben dama ben achoto shel rabbi yishmael et rabbi yishmael: raiti shene lechayay shennashru. amar: shene gedude romi yaatzu alecha raa, umetu.

Amar leh bar kappara lerabbi: raiti chotmi shennashar. amar leh: charon af nistallek mimmecha. amar leh: raiti shene yaday shennechtechu. amar leh: lo titztarech lemaase yadecha. amar leh: raiti shete raglay shennikteu. amar leh: al sus atta rochev. chazay deamri li baadar maytat venisan la chazet. amar leh: beadruta maytat vela atet lide nissayon.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yishmael: raiti sheani mashke shemen lezetim. amar leh: ba al immo. amar leh: chazay diktif li kochva. amar leh: bar yisrael genavt. amar leh: chazay divlateh lechochva. amar leh: bar yisrael zabbenteh vaachalt lidmeh. amar leh: chazay enay denashkan ahadade. amar leh: ba al achoto. amar leh: chazay dinshaki sehara. amar leh: ba al eshet yisrael. amar leh: chazay dedarechna betuna deasa. amar leh: ba al naara hameorasa. amar leh: chazay tuna meillay vehu mittattay. amar leh: mishkavcha hafuch. amar leh: chazay orve dehadri lefureyeh. amar leh: ishtecha zanta meanashim harebe. amar leh: chazay yone dehadri lefureyeh. amar leh: nashim harebe timmeta. amar leh: chazay denaketna tere yone ufarchan. amar leh: tarte neshe nesavt ufetartinnun bela get.

Amar leh: chazay dekalefna bee. amar leh: shachve ka meshallechat. amar leh: kullehu itanhu bi, bar meha deleteh. addehachi vehachi atya hay itteta veamra leh: hay gelima demikkassat — degavra peloni hu, demit veashlachteh.

Amar leh: chazay deamri li: shevak lach avuch nichse bekappodkeya. amar leh: it lach nichse bekappodkeya? amar leh lav. azal avuch lekappodkeya? amar leh: lav. im ken: kappa keshura, deka asra. zil chazi kappa deresh asra shehi melea zuze. azal ashkach shehi melea zuze.

Amar rabbi chanina: haroe beer bachalom — roe shalom, shenneemar: "vayyachperu avde yitzchak bannachal vayyimtzeu sham beer mayim chayyim". rabbi natan omer: matza tora — shenneemar: "ki motzi matza chayyim", uchetiv hacha: "beer mayim chayyim". rava amar: chayyim mammash.

Amar rabbi chanan shalosh shelomot hen: nahar, tzippor, ukedera. nahar — dichtiv: "hinni note eleha kenahar shalom". tzippor — dichtiv: "ketzipporim afot ken yagen Adonai tzevaot vegomer". kedera — dichtiv: "Adonai tishpot shalom lanu". amar rabbi chanina: uvikdera sheen bah basar shaninu. "ufarsu kaasher bassir uchevasar betoch kallachat".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe nahar bachalom, yashkim veyomar: "hinni note eleha kenahar shalom", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "ki yavo channahar tzar". haroe tzippor bachalom, yashkim veyomar "ketzipporim afot ken yagen vegomer", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "ketzippor nodedet min kinnah vegomer". haroe kedera bachalom, yashkim veyomar: "Adonai tishpot shalom lanu", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "shefot hassir shefot".

Haroe anavim bachalom, yashkim veyomar "kaanavim bammidbar", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "anavemo inneve rosh". haroe har bachalom, yashkim veyomar — "ma navu al heharim ragle mevasser", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "al heharim essa vechi vanehi".
Haroe shofar bachalom, yashkim veyomar "vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "tiku shofar baggiva".

Haroe kelev bachalom, yashkim veyomar "ulechol bene yisrael lo yecheratz kelev leshono", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "vehakkelavim azze nefesh". haroe ari bachalom, yashkim veyomar "arye shaag mi lo yira", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "ala arye missubbecho".

Haroe tiglachat bachalom, yashkim veyomar "vaygallach vaychallef simlotav", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "ki im gullachti vesar mimmenni chochi". haroe beer bachalom, yashkim veyomar "beer mayim chayyim", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "kehakir bayir memeha". haroe kane bachalom, yashkim veyomar "kane ratzutz lo yishbor", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "hinne vatachta lecha al mishenet hakkane haratzutz".

Tanu rabbanan: haroe kane bachalom — yetzappe lechochma, shenneemar: "kene chachma". kanim — yetzappe levina, shenneemar: "uvechol kinyancha kene vina". amar rabbi zera: kara, kura, kira, kanya — kullehu meallu lechelma. tanya: en marin dilluin ella lemi shehu yere shamayim bechol kocho.
Haroe shor bachalom, yashkim veyomar "bechor shoro hadar lo", kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher — "ki yiggach shor et ish".

Tanu rabbanan: chamishsha devarim neemru beshor. haochel mibbesaro — mitashsher. negacho — havyin leh banim shemnaggechim battora. neshacho — yissurin baim alav. beato — derech rechoka nizdammena lo. rechavo — ole ligdulla.
Vehatanya rechavo — met! la kashya, ha derachev hu letora. ha, derachev tora ledideh.

Haroe chamor bachalom — yetzappe lishua, shenneemar: "hinne malkech yavo lach tzaddik venosha hu ani verochev al chamor". haroe chatul bachalom — beatra dekaru leh "shunnara" — naaset lo shira naa. "shinnara" — naase lo shinnuy ra. haroe anavim bachalom, levanot, ben bizmannan, uven shello bizmannan — yafot. shechorot bizmannan — yafot. shello bizmannan — raot. haroe sus lavan bachalom, ben benachat, ben beraduf — yafe lo. adom, benachat — yafe, beraduf — kashe.

Haroe yishmael bachalom — tefillato nishmaat. vedavka yishmael ben avraham, aval tayyaya bealma — la. haroe gamal bachalom — mita niknesa lo min hashshamayim vehitztziluhu mimmenna. amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may keraa — "veanochi ered immecha mitzrayma veanochi aalcha gam alo". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mehacha: "gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut".
Haroe pinchas bachalom — pele naasa lo. haroe pil bachalom — pelaot naasu lo. pilim — pile pelaot naasu lo.
Vehatanya kol mine chayyot yafin lachalom, chutz min happil umin hakkof! la kashya,

a: Ha dimsarag, ha dela mesarag. haroe huna bachalom — nes naasa lo. chanina, chananya, yochanan — nisse nissim naasu lo. haroe hesped bachalom — min hashshamayim chasu alav ufedauhu. vehane mille bichtava.
Haone "yehe shemeh rabba mevarach" — muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba. hakkore keriat shema — rauy shettishre alav shechina, ella sheen doro zakkay lechach.

Hammanniach tefillin bachalom — yetzappe ligdulla, shenneemar: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha vegomer". vetanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh. hammitpallel bachalom — siman yafe lo. vehane mille dela sayyem.

Habba al immo bachalom — yetzappe levina, shenneemar: "ki im labbina tikra". habba al naara meorasa — yetzappe letora, shenneemar: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov", al tikre "morasha" ella "meorasa". habba al achoto bachalom — yetzappe lechochma, shenneemar: "emor lachochma achoti at". habba al eshet ish bachalom — muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba. vehane mille dela yada la vela harehar ba meureta.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: haroe chittim bachalom — raa shalom, shenneemar: "hassam gevulech shalom chelev chittim yasbiech". haroe seorim bachalom — saru avonotav, shenneemar: "vesar avonecha vechattatcha techuppar". amar rabbi zera: ana la selaki mibbavel leeretz yisrael ad dachazay seare bechelma.
Haroe gefen teuna bachalom — en ishto mappelet nefalim, shenneemar: "eshtecha kegefen poriyya". soreka — yetzappe lammashiach, shenneemar: "osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono".

Haroa teena bachalom — torato mishtammeret bekirbo, shenneemar: "notzer teena yochal piryah". haroe rimmonim bachalom, zutere — pare iskeh kerimmona, ravreve — rave iskeh kerimmona. palge, im talmid chacham hu — yetzappe letora, shenneemar: "ashkecha miyyayin harekach measis rimmoni". veim am haaretz hu — yetzappe lemitzvot, shenneemar: "kefelach harimmon rakkatech". may rakkatech — afillu rekanin shebbach, meleim mitzvot kerimmon.

Haroe zetim bachalom, zutere — pare verave vekae iskeh kezetim. vehane mille pere, aval ilane — havyin leh banim merubbin, shenneemar: "banecha kishtile zetim vegomer". ikka deamri haroe zayit bachalom — shem tov yotze lo, shenneemar: "zayit raanan yefe feri toar kara Adonai shemech". haroe shemen zayit bachalom — yetzappe limor tora, shenneemar: "veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach". haroe temarim bachalom — tammu avonotav, shenneemar: "tam avonech bat tziyyon".

Amar rav yosef, haroe ez bachalom — shana mitbarechet lo, izzim — shanim mitbarchot lo, shenneemar: "vede chalev izzim lelachmecha". haroe hadas bachalom — nechasav matzlichin lo. veim en lo nechasim — yerushsha nofelet lo mimmakom acher. amar ulla, veamri la bematnita tana: vehu dachaza bechannayyhu. haroe etrog bachalom — hadur hu lifne kono, shenneemar: "peri etz hadar kappot temarim". haroe lulav bachalom — en lo ella lev echad leaviv shebbashshamayim.
Haroe auoz bachalom — yetzappe lechochma shenneemar: "chochmot bachutz taronna". vehabba aleha have rosh yeshiva. amar rav ashe: ani reitiha, uvati aleha, uselekit ligdulla.

Haroe tarnegol bachalom — yetzappe leven zachar. tarnegolim — yetzappe levanim zecharim. tarnegolet — yetzappe letarbitza naa vegila. haroe betzim bachalom — teluya bakkashato. nishtabberu — naaset bakkashato. vechen egozim, vechen kishshuim, vechen kol kele zechuchit, vechen kol hannishbarim kaellu.
Hannichnas lakkerach — naasu lo chafatzav, shenneemar: "vayyanchem el mechoz cheftzam". hamegalleach rosho bachalom — siman yafe lo. rosho uzekano — lo ulechol mishpachto.
Hayyoshev baareva ketanna — shem tov yotze lo. baareva gedola — lo ulechol mishpachto. vehane mille demiddalya dalloye.
Hannifne bachalom — siman yafe lo, shenneemar: "mihar tzoe lehippateach". vehane mille dela kannach.

Haole laggag bachalom — ole ligdulla. yarad — yored miggedullato. abbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: kevan sheala — ala. hakkorea begadav bachalom — korim lo gezar dino. haomed arom bachalom, bevavel — omed belo chet. beeretz yisrael — arom belo mitzvot. hannitpas lesardeyot — shemira naaset lo. netanuhu bekolar — hosifu lo shemira al shemirato. vehane mille bekolar, aval chavla bealma — la.
Hannichnas laagam bachalom — naase rosh yeshiva. leyaar — naase rosh livne challa.

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua chazo chelma: rav pappa deayel leagma — naasa rosh yeshiva. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua deayel leyaar — naasa rosh livne kalla. ikka deamri tarvavyyhu leagma ayyli, ella rav pappa ditle tavla — naasa rosh yeshiva, rav huna bereh derav yehoshua dela tele tavla — naasa rosh livne kalla. amar rav ashe: ana ayaylit leagma utelay tavla venabbachi ba nabboche.
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak: hammakkiz dam bachalom — avonotav mechulin lo.
Vehatanya: avonotav sedurin lo! may sedurin — sedurin limmachel.

Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: haroe nachash bachalom parnasato mezummenet lo. neshacho — nichpela lo. harago — avda parnasato. amar leh rav sheshet: kol shekken shennichpela parnasato. vela hi, rav sheshet hu dachaza chivya bechelmeh vekatleh.

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol mine mashkin yafin lachalom chutz min hayyayin, yesh shotehu vetov lo, veyesh shotehu vera lo. yesh shotehu vetov lo — shenneemar: "veyayin yesammach levav enosh", veyesh shotehu vera lo — shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh".
Amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: teni: talmid chacham leolam tov lo, shenneemar: "lechu lachamu velachami ushetu beyayin masachti".
b: Amar rabbi yochanan: hishkim venafal pasuk letoch piv — hare ze nevua ketanna. tanu rabbanan, shelosha melachim hem: haroe david bachalom — yetzappe lachasidut. shelomo — yetzappe lechochma. achav — yidag min happureanut.
Shelosha neviim hem: haroe sefer melachim — yetzappe ligdulla. yechezkel — yetzappe lechochma. yeshaya — yetzappe lenechama. yirmeya — yidag min happureanut.
Shelosha ketuvim gedolim hem: haroe sefer tehillim — yetzappe lachasidut, mishle — yetzappe lechochma, iyyov — yidag min happureanut.
Shelosha ketuvim ketannim hem: haroe shir hashshirim bachalom — yetzappe lachasidut. kohelet — yetzappe lechochma. kinot — yidag min happureanut. haroe megillat ester — nes naasa lo.
Shelosha chachamim hem: haroe rabbi bachalom — yetzappe lechochma. rabbi elazar ben azarya — yetzappe laashirut. rabbi yishmael ben elisha — yidag min happureanut.
Shelosha talmide chachamim hem: haroe ben azzay bachalom — yetzappe lachasidut. ben zoma — yetzappe lechochma. acher — yidag min happureanut.
Kol mine chayyot yafot lachalom, chutz min happil vehakkof vehakkippod. vehaamar mar, haroe pil bachalom pele naasa lo! la kashya, ha dimsarag, ha dela mesarag.

Kol mine mattechet yafin lachalom, chutz mimmar, pesal, vekardom. vehane mille dachazanhu bekattayyhu. kol mine perot yafin lachalom, chutz mippagge temara. kol mine yerakot yafin lachalom, chutz merashe lefatot. vehaamar rav: la iattari ad dachazay rashay lefatot! ki chaza — bechannayyhu chaza. kol mine tzivonin yafin lachalom, chutz min hattechelet. kol mine ofot yafin lachalom, chutz min karya vekippofa vekurepray.
(Hagguf, hagguf, meen, meshivin, umarchivin, siman).

Shelosha nichnasin lagguf, veen hagguf nehene mehen: gudegdaniyyot, vechafniyyot, ufagge temara. shelosha en nichnasin lagguf, vehagguf nehene mehen, ellu hen: rechitza, vesicha, vetashmish. shelosha meen haolam habba, ellu hen: shabbat, shemesh, vetashmish.
Tashmish demay? illema tashmish hammitta — ha michchash kachesh! ella tashmish nekavim.
Shelosha meshivin dato shel adam, ellu hen: kol, umare, vareach. shelosha marchivin dato shel adam, ellu hen: dira naa, veishsha naa, vechelim naim.

Chamishsha veshishsha vaasara siman: chamishsha echad mishshishshim, ellu hen: esh, devash, veshabbat, veshena, vachalom. esh — echad mishshishshim legehinnam. devash — echad mishshishshim lamman. shabbat — echad mishshishshim laolam habba. shena — echad mishshishshim lammita. chalom — echad mishshishshim lannevua.

Shishsha devarim siman yafe lachole, ellu hen: ittush, zea, shilshul, keri, veshena, vachalom. ittush — dichtiv: "atishotav tahel or". zea — dichtiv: "bezeat appecha tochal lechem". shilshul — dichtiv: "mihar tzoe lehippateach velo yamut lashshachat". keri — dichtiv: "yire zera yaarich yamim". shena — dichtiv: "yashanti az yanuach li". chalom — dichtiv: "vetachalimeni vehachayeni".

Shishsha devarim merappein et hachole mecholyo urefuato refua, ellu hen: keruv, uteradin, vesisin yeveshin, vekeva, veheret, veyoteret hakkaved. veyesh omrim: af dagim ketannim. vela od, ella sheddagim ketannim mafrin umavrin kol gufo shel adam.

Asara devarim machazirin et hachole lecholyo, vecholyo kashe, ellu hen: haochel besar shor, basar shamen, besar tzali, besar tzipporim, uvetza tzeluya, vetiglachat, veshachalayim, vehechalav, vehaggevina vehammerchatz. veyesh omrim af egozim. veyesh omrim af kishshuim.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: lamma nikra sheman kishshuim — mippene shehen kashin lagguf kacharavot. ini, vehachtiv: "vayyomer Adonai lah shene goyim bevitnech": al tikre "goyim" ella "geyim", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: ellu antoninus verabbi, shello pasak mishshulchanam lo tzenon velo chazeret velo kishshuin, lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim.
La kashya: ha beravreve, ha bezutere.

Tanu rabbanan: met babbayit — shalom babbayit. achal veshata babbayit — siman yafe labbayit. natal kelim min habbayit — siman ra labbayit. targema rav pappa bimsana vesandala. kol deshakel shachva — mealle, bar mimmesana vesandala. kol deyahev shachva — mealle, bar meafra vechardela.

Makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara. tanu rabbanan: haroe markulis, omer: "baruch … shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono". makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara, omer: "baruch … sheakar avoda zara meartzenu. ucheshem shenneekra mimmakom ze ken teaker mikkol mekomot yisrael, vehashev lev ovdehem leovdecha". uvechutz laaretz en tzarich lomar "vehashev lev ovdehem leovdecha" mippene sherubbah goyim. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bechutz laaretz tzarich lomar ken, mippene sheatidim lehitgayyer, shenneemar: "az ehpoch el ammim safa verura".

Darash rav hamenuna: haroe bavel harshaa tzarich levarech chamesh berachot. raa bavel, omer: "baruch … shehecheriv bavel harshaa". raa beto shel nevuchadnetztzar, omer: "baruch … shehecheriv beto shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha". raa gov shel arayot o kivshan haesh, omer: "baruch … sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze". raa markulis, omer: "baruch … shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono". raa makom shennotlin mimmennu afar, omer: "baruch … omer veose gozer umekayyem".

Rava ki hava chaze chamare deshakli afra, taref lehu yeda al gabbayyhu, veamar: rehutu tzaddike lemebad reuta demarayychu. mar bereh deravina ki hava mate levavel hava shakel afra besudareh veshade levara, lekayyem ma shenneemar "vetetetiha bematate hashemed". amar rav ashe: ana, ha derav hamenuna la shemia li, ella middatay barechtinhu lechullehu.

a: Amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: nitkallela bavel — nitkallelu shecheneha. nitkallela shomron — nitbarchu shecheneha: nitkallela bavel — nitkallelu shecheneha, dichtiv: "vesamtiha lemorash kippod veagme mayim". nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha — dichtiv: "vesamti shomron lei hassade lemattae charem vegomer".
Veamar rav hamenuna: haroe ucheluse yisrael, omer: "baruch … chacham harazim". ucheluse goyim, omer: "bosha immechem vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: haroe ucheluse yisrael, omer: "baruch … chacham harazim" — sheen datam doma ze laze, veen partzufehen domim ze laze. ben zoma raa uchelusa al gav maala behar habbayit, amar: "baruch … chacham harazim uvaruch … shebbara kol ellu leshammesheni".

Hu haya omer: kamma yegiot yaga adam harishon ad shemmatza pat leechol: charash, vezara, vekatzar, veimmer, vedash, vezara, uvarar, vetachan, vehirkid, velash, veafa, veachar kach achal. vaani mashkim umotze kol ellu metukkanin lefanay. vechamma yegiot yaga adam harishon ad shemmatza beged lilbosh: gazaz, velibben, venippetz, vetava, vearag, veachar kach matza beged lilbosh, vaani mashkim umotze kol elle metukkanim lefanay. kol ummot shokdot uvaot lefetach beti, vaani mashkim umotze kol ellu lefanay.

Hu haya omer: oreach tov mahu omer? — kamma terachot tarach baal habbayit bishvili, kamma basar hevi lefanay, kamma yayin hevi lefanay, kamma gelusekaot hevi lefanay, vechol ma shettarach — lo tarach ella bishvili. aval oreach ra mahu omer? — ma torach tarach baal habbayit ze? pat achat achalti, chaticha achat achalti, kos echad shatiti, kol torach shettarach baal habbayit ze — lo tarach ella bishvil ishto uvanav.
Al oreach tov mahu omer? — "zechor ki tasgi foolo asher shorru anashim". al oreach ra ketiv: "lachen yereuhu anashim vegomer".

"Vehaish bime shaul zaken ba vaanashim". amar rava, veittema rav zevid, veittema rav oshaya: ze yishay avi david sheyyatza beuchelusa, venichnas beuchelusa, vedarash beuchelusa. amar ulla: nekitinan en uchelusa bevavel. tana: en uchelusa pechuta mishshishshim ribbo.

Tanu rabbanan: haroe chachme yisrael, omer "baruch … shechalak mechochmato lireav". chachme ummot haolam, omer: "baruch … shennatan mechochmato levasar vadam". haroe malche yisrael, omer: "baruch … shechalak mikkevodo lireav". malche ummot haolam, omer: "baruch … shennatan mikkevodo levasar vadam".

Amar rabbi yochanan: leolam yishtaddel adam larutz likrat malche yisrael. velo likrat malche yisrael bilvad, ella afillu likrat malche ummot haolam, sheim yizke — yavchin ben malche yisrael lemalche ummot haolam.

Rav sheshet saggi nehor hava. havo kaazli kulle alma lekabbole appe malka, vekam azal bahadayyhu rav sheshet. ashkecheh hahu mina, amar leh: chatzve lenahra, kagne leyay? amar leh: ta chazi deyadana tefe minnach. chalaf guneda kammayyta. ki ka avvsha, amar leh hahu mina: ata malka. amar leh rav sheshet: la kaate. chalaf guneda tinyayna. ki ka avvsha, amar leh hahu mina: hasheta ka ate malka. amar leh rav sheshet: la ka ate malka. chalef telitay. ki ka shatka, amar leh rav sheshet: vadday hasheta ate malka.

Amar leh hahu mina: mena lach ha? amar leh: demalchuta deara keen malchuta dirkia, dichtiv: "tze veamadta vahar lifne Adonai vehinne Adonai over veruach gedola vechazak mefarek harim umeshabber selaim lifne Adonai lo varuach Adonai veachar haruach raash lo varaash Adonai. veachar haraash esh lo vaesh Adonai veachar haesh kol demama dakka".

Ki ata malka, patach rav sheshet veka mevarech leh. amar leh hahu mina: leman dela chazet leh ka mevarchat? umay havi aleh dehahu mina? ikka deamri: chavrohi kachlinhu leeneh, veikka deamri: rav sheshet natan enav bo, venaasa gal shel atzamot.

Rabbi shela naggedeh lehahu gavra dival goya. azal achal beh kuretze be malka, amar: ikka chad gavra bihudae deka dayen dina bela haremana demalka. shaddar aleh peristeka. ki ata amri leh: may tama naggedteh lehay? amar lehu: deva al chamarta. amri leh: it lecha sahadi? amar lehu: in. ata eliyyahu iddemi leh keinish, veashed. amri leh: i hachi, bar ketala hu! amar lehu: anan miyyoma diglenan mearin let lan reshuta lemiktal. attun, may devaetun avidu beh.

Ad dimayyeyni beh bedina, petach rabbi shela vaamar: "lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vegomer". amri leh: may kaamrat? amar lehu, hachi kaamena: "berich rachamana deyahev malchuta beara keen malchuta dirkia, vihav lechu shuletana verachami dina". amaru: chabbiva aleh yekara demalchuta kulle hay! yahavi leh kulefa amaru leh: dun dina.

Ki hava nafek, amar leh hahu gavra: aved rachamana nissa leshakkare hachi? amar leh: rasha, lav chamare ikkeru? dichtiv: "asher besar chamorim besaram". chazyeh dekaazel lememra lehu dikrinhu chamare, amar: hay rodef hu. vehattora amra: im ba lehorgecha — hashekem lehorgo. machyeh bekulefa vekatleh.

Amar: hoil veitavid li nissa behay kera, dareshna leh: "lecha Adonai haggedulla" — zo maase vereshit, vechen hu omer: "ose gedolot ad en cheker". "vehaggevura" — zo yetziat mitzrayim, shenneemar: "vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vegomer". "vehattiferet" — zo chamma ulevana sheamdu lo lihoshua, shenneemar: "vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad vegomer". "vehannetzach" — zo mappaltah shel romi. vechen hu omer: "veyez nitzcham al begaday vegomer". "vehahod" — zo milchemet nachale arnon, shenneemar: "al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa vegomer". "ki chol bashshamayim uvaaretz" — zo milchemet sisra, shenneemar: "min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim mimmesillotam vegomer". "lecha Adonai hammamlacha" — zo milchemet amalek, vechen hu omer: "ki yad al kes yah". "vehammitnasse" — zo milchemet gog umagog, vechen hu omer: "hinni elecha gog nesi rosh meshech vetuval". "lechol lerosh" — amar rav chanan bar rava amar rabbi yochanan: afillu resh gargita min shemayya mannu leh.

Bematnita tanna mishshemeh derabbi akiva: "lecha Adonai haggedulla" — zo keriat yam suf. "vehaggevura" — zo makkat bechorot. "vehattiferet" — zo mattan tora. "vehannetzach" — zo yerushalayim. "vehahod" — zo bet hammikdash.
b: Tanu rabbanan: haroe batte yisrael beyishshuvan, omer: "baruch … matztziv gevul almana". bechurebanan, omer: "baruch dayyayn haemet". batte ummot haolam beyishshuvan, omer: "bet geim yissach Adonai". bechurebanan, omer: "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia".

Ulla verav chisda havo ka azli beorcha. ki meto appitcha deve rav chana bar chanilay negad rav chisda veittenach. amar leh ulla: ammay ka mittenachat? vehaamar rav: anacha shoveret chatzi gufo shel adam, shenneemar: "veatta ven adam heanach beshivron motnayim vegomer". verabbi yochanan amar af kol gufo shel adam, shenneemar: "vehaya ki yomru elecha al ma atta neenach veamarta el shemua chi vaa venames kol lev vegomer".

Amar leh: hechi la ettenach — beta dahavo ba shittin afyayta bimama veshittin afyayta belelya, veafyayn lechol man ditzrich, vela shekal yeda min kisa, disvar dilma ate ane bar tovim veaddematu leh lechisa ka mikkesif. vetu, havo petichin leh arba bave learba ruchata dealma, vechol dahava ayel kafen nafek ki sava. vahavo shadu leh chitte useare bishne vatztzoret abbaray, dechol man dichsifa milleta lemishkal bimama, ate veshakel belelya. hasheta nefal betilla — vela ettenach?

Amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan — miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nigzera gezera al battehen shel tzaddikim sheyyechervu, shenneemar: "beoznay Adonai tzevaot im lo battim rabbim leshamma yihyu gedolim vetovim meen yoshev". veamar rabbi yochanan: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran leyishshuvan, shenneemar: "shir hammaalot ledavid habbotchim baAdonai kehar tziyyon". ma har tziyyon atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziro leyishshuvo, af battehen shel tzaddikim atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran leyishshuvan. chazyeh dela meyayshsheva dateh. amar leh: dayyo leeved sheyyehe kerabbo.

Tanu rabbanan: haroe kivre yisrael, omer: "baruch … asher yatzar etchem baddin, vezan etchem baddin, vechilkel etchem baddin, veasaf etchem baddin, veatid lahakimchem baddin". mar bereh deravina mesayyem ba, mishshemeh derav nachman: "veyodea mispar kullechem, vehu atid lehacheyotchem ulekayyem etchem. baruch … mechayye hammetim". kivre goyim, omer: "bosha immechem vegomer".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe et chavero leachar sheloshim yom, omer: "baruch … shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". leachar shenem asar chodesh, omer: "baruch … mechayye hammetim". amar rav: en hammet mishtakkeach min hallev ella leachar shenem asar chodesh. shenneemar: "nishkachti kemet millev hayiti kichli oved".

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua havo kaazli beorcha. pegau beh berav chanina bereh derav ika. amaru leh: bahade dachazenach barechinan alach tarte: "baruch … asher chalak mechochmato lireav" veshehecheyaynu". amar lehu: ana name, kevan dachazitinchu chashshevtinchu illavay keshittin ribbevon bet yisrael, uvarechna alayychu telata: hanach tarte, uvaruch … chacham harazim". amaru leh: chachimat kulle hay! yahavi beh enayyhu, ushechev.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe et habbahakanim, omer: "baruch … meshanne habberiyyot". metivi: raa et hakkushi, veet haggichor, veet hallavvkan, veet hakkippeach, veet hannannas, veet haddarnikos, omer: "baruch … meshanne et habberiyyot". et hakkittea, veet hassome, veet petuye harosh, veet hachigger, veet hammukke shechin, veet habbahakanim, omer: "baruch … dayyen emet"!
La kashya: ha mimmee immo, ha batar deityelid. dayka name, dekatane dumeya dekittea. shema minna.
Tanu rabbanan: haroa pil, kof vekifof, omer: "baruch … meshanne et habberiyyot". raa beriyyot tovot, veilanot tovot, omer: "baruch … shekkacha lo beolamo".

Al hazzikin: may zikin? amar shemuel: kochva deshavet. veamar shemuel: nehirin li shevile dishmayya kishvile dinhardaa, levar mikkochva deshavet dela yadana may nihu. ugemiri dela avar kisla, vei avar kisla — charev alma. veha ka chazenan deavar! — ziveh hu deavar, umitchaze kidavar ihu. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: vilon hu demikkera, demiggalgal umichaze nehora derakia. rav ashe amar: kochva hu deakar mehay gisa dechisla vechaze leh chavreh mehach gisa, umibbeit, umichaze keman deavar.

Shemuel rame. ketiv "ose ash kesil vechima", uchetiv: "ose chima uchesil". ha ketzad? ilmale chamma shel kesil, lo nitkayyem olam mippene tzinna shel kima, veilmale tzinna shel kima — lo nitkayyem olam mippene chamma shel kesil.

Ugemiri i lav uketza deakrabba demannach binhar dinur, kol man dahava tarka leh akrabba la hava chaye. vehayeynu dekaamar leh rachamana leiyyov: "hatekashsher maadannot kima o moshchot kesil tefatteach".
May "kima"? amar shemuel: kima kochve. amri la dimchannefi, veamri la dimvadderan.
May "ash"? amar rav yehuda: yota. may "yota"? amri la zenav tale. veamri la resha deigla. umistabbera keman deamar zenav tale, dichtiv: "veayish al baneha tanchem". alma chasra umitchazya

a: Ketirpa ditrif. vehay deazla batra, deamra la: hav li benay. shebbeshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu bikkesh lehavi mabbul leolam natal shene kochavim mikkima vehevi mabbul laolam. ucheshebbikkesh lesotmah, natal shene kochavim meayish usetamah.
Velayhdar la? — en habbor mitmalle mechuleyato. i name — en kategor naasa sanegor.
Velivre la tere kochve acharine! — "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh". amar rav nachman: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran lah, shenneemar: "veayish al baneha tanchem".

Veal hazzevaot. may zevaot? amar rav kattina: guha. rav kattina hava kaazel beorcha. ki meta appitcha deve ova tamya genach guha. amar: mi yada ova tamya hay guha mahu? rema leh kala: kattina kattina, ammay la yadana? beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu zocher et banav sheshsheruyim betzaar ben ummot haolam morid shete demaot layyam haggadol, vekolo nishma missof haolam vead sofo, vehayeynu guha.
Amar rav kattina: ova tamya kaddiv hu, umilleh kedivin. i hachi — guha guha mibbee leh? vela hi, guha guha aved, vehay dela odi leh, ki hechi dela lite kulle alma abbatreh.

Verav kattina dideh amar: sofek kappav, shenneemar: "vegam ani akke chappi el kappi vahanichoti chamati". rabbi natan omer: anacha mitanneach, shenneemar: "vahanichoti chamati bam vehinnechamti". verabbanan amri: boet barakia, shenneemar: "hedad kedorchim yaane el kol yoshve haaretz". rav acha bar yaakov amar: dochek et raglav tachat kisse hakkavod, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay".

Veal haramim. may reamim? amar shemuel: anane begalgalla. shenneemar: "kol raamcha baggalgal heiru verakim tevel ragza vattirash haaretz". verabbanan amri: anane deshafchi mayya lahadade, shenneemar: "lekol titto hamon mayim bashshamayim". rav acha bar yaakov amar: barka takkifa devarek baanana, umetabbar gezize devarza. rav ashe amar: anane chalchole mechalchali, veate zika umenashshev appummayyhu, vedame kezikka al pum danne. umistabbera kerav acha bar yaakov, devarek barka, umenahame anane, veate mitra.

Veal haruchot. may ruchot? amar abbaye: zapa. veamar abbaye: gemiri, dezapa belelya la have. veha ka chazenan dehave! — hahu, deatchel bimama. veamar abbaye: gemiri, dezapa tarte shae la kae, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "lo takum paamayim tzara". veha ka chazenan dekae! — demafsek bene bene.

Veal habberakim omer "baruch … shekkocho ugevurato male olam". may berakim? amar rava: barka. veamar rava: barka yechidaa, uvarka chivvara, uvarka yeruketa, vaanane desalkan bekeren maaravit veatyayn mikkeren deromit, vetarte anane desalkan chada leappe chavertah — kullehu kashyayn.
Lemay nafka minna? lemive rachame. vehane mille belelya, aval betzafra — let behu meshasha.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: hane anane detzafra let behu meshasha, dichtiv: "vechasdechem kaanan boker vegomer". amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ha amri inashe: kad miftach bave mitra, bar chammara, much sakkaych ugeni! la kashya: ha diktir beeva, ha diktir baanane.

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo nivreu reamim ella lifshot akmumit shebballev, shenneemar: "vehaelohim asa sheyyiru millefanav". veamar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe et hakkeshet beanan tzarich sheyyippol al panav, shenneemar: "kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan vegomer vaere vaeppol al panay". layyti ala bemareva, mishshum demichaze keman desaged lekashta. aval baroche vadday mevarech. may mevarech? — "baruch … zocher habberit". bematnita tana, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: "neeman bivrito vekayyaym bemaamaro". amar rav pappa: hilkach nemrinhu letarvayyhu: "baruch … zocher habberit, veneeman bivrito vekayyaym bemaamaro".

Al heharim veal haggevaot. attu kol hane daamaran ad hasheta, lav maase vereshit ninhu? vehachtiv "berakim lammatar asa"! amar abbaye: keroch uteni. rava amar: hatam mevarech tarte — "baruch … shekkocho male olam", veose maase vereshit". hacha "ose maase vereshit" — ikka, "shekkocho male olam" lekka.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe rakia betohoratah, omer: "baruch … ose vereshit". immatti? amar abbaye: ki ate mitra kulle lelya, uvetzafra ate istana umegalleya lehu lishmayya.

Ufeliga derafram bar pappa amar rav chisda. deamar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash lo niret rakia betohoratah, shenneemar: "albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam".
b: Tanu rabbanan: haroe chamma bitkufatah, levana bigvuratah, vechochavim bimsillotam, umazzalot kesidran, omer: "baruch … ose vereshit". veemat have? amar abbaye: kol esrin utemanya shenin, vehadar machzor venafla tekufat nisan, beshabbetay beureta ditlat naghe arba.
Rabbi yehuda omer haroe hayyam vechulei lifrakim. ad kamma? amar rame bar abba amar rav yitzchak: ad sheloshim yom.

Veamar rame bar abba amar rav yitzchak: haroe perat aggishra devavel, omer: "baruch … ose vereshit". vehaiddana deshanyu parsae — mibbe shabbur uleel. rav yosef amar: meihi dekira uleel. veamar rame bar abba: haroe diglat aggishra deshavistena, omer: "baruch … ose bereshit".
May "chiddekel" — amar rav ashe: shemmemav chaddin vekallin. may "perat"? — shemmemav parin veravin.
Veamar rava: hay dacharife bene machoza — mishshum deshatu mayya dediglat. hay degichore — mishshum dimshammeshi bimama. vehay denayydi enayyhu — mishshum dedayyru bevayit afel.
Al haggeshamim kulei. veal haggeshamim "hattov vehammetiv" mevarech? vehaamar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: meematay mevarchin al haggeshamim — mishsheyyetze chatan likrat kalla.

May mevarchin? amar rav yehuda: "modim anachnu lach al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu". verabbi yochanan mesayyem ba hachi: "illu finu male shira kayyam vechulei en anachnu maspikin lehodot lecha Adonai elohenu", ad "tishtachave". "baruch atta Adonai rov hahodaot".
"Rov hahodaot" vela kol hahodaot? amar rava: ema — "hael hahodaot". amar rav pappa: hilkach nemrinhu letarvayyhu, "rov hahodaot" vehael hahodaot".
Veella kashya! — la kashya, ha dishma mishma, ha dachaza michze.
Dishma mishma hayeynu besorot tovot, utenan: al besorot tovot omer "baruch hattov vehammetiv"!
Ella: idde veidde dachaza michze, vela kashya: ha daata pureta, ha daata tuva. veibbaet ema: ha veha daata tuva, vela kashya — ha deit leh ara, ha delet leh ara.

It leh ara "hattov vehammetiv" mevarech?! veha tenan: bana bayit chadash, vekana kelim chadashim, omer: "baruch … shehecheyaynu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze". shello veshel acherim — omer: "hattov vehammetiv"?

La kashya: ha deit leh shuttafut, ha delet leh shuttafut. vehatanya: kotzro shel davar, al shello hu omer: "baruch … shehecheyaynu vekiyyeymanu", al shello veal shel chavero — omer: "baruch … hattov vehammetiv".
Vechol hecha delet leacharina bahadeh la mevarech "hattov vehammetiv"? vehatanya: amru leh yalda ishto zachar, omer "baruch … hattov vehammetiv"! hatam name, deikka ishto bahadeh denicha la bezachar.
Ta shema: met aviv vehu yorsho, battechilla omer: "baruch … dayyayn haemet", ulevassof hu omer: "baruch … hattov vehammetiv". hatam name deikka ache deka yarti bahadeh.

Ta shema: shinnuy yayin eno tzarich levarech, shinnuy makom tzarich levarech. veamar rabbi yosef bar abba amar rabbi yochanan af al pi sheamru shinnuy yayin eno tzarich levarech, aval omer: "baruch … hattov vehammetiv"! hatam name, deikka bene chavura deshatu bahadeh.

Bana bayit chadash vekana kelim chadashim vechulei. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella sheen lo kayyotze bahen, aval yesh lo kayyotze bahen — eno tzarich levarech. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu yesh lo kayyotze bahen, tzarich levarech.

a: Mikkelal dechi kana vechazar vekana, divre hakkol en tzarich levarech.

Veikka deamri: amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello kana vechazar vekana, aval kana vechazar vekana — en tzarich levarech. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu kana chazar vekana — tzarich levarech. mikkelal dechi yesh lo vekana — divre hakkol tzarich levarech.

Metivi: bana bayit chadash veen lo kayyotze bo, kana kelim chadashim veen lo kayyotze bahem — tzarich levarech. yesh lo kayyotze bahem — en tzarich levarech, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach tzarich levarech.

Bishlama lelishshana kamma — rav huna kerabbi meir, verabbi yochanan kerabbi yehuda. ella lelishshana batra, bishlama rav huna kerabbi yehuda, ella rabbi yochanan deamar keman? la kerabbi meir vela kerabbi yehuda!

Amar lach rabbi yochanan: hu haddin dilrabbi yehuda kana vechazar vekana — name tzarich levarech. veha deka mippalgi beyesh lo vekana, lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir daafillu kana veyesh lo — en tzarich levarech, vechol shekken kana vechazar vekana deen tzarich levarech.
Velippalgu bekana vechazar vekana deen tzarich levarech, lehodiacha kocho derabbi yehuda! koach dehettera adif leh.
Mevarech al haraa kulei.
Hechi dame? kegon dishkal bidka beareh, af al gav detava hi ledideh, demasseka ara sirton veshavcha, hasheta miha raa hi.
Veal hattova kulei.
Hechi dame? kegon deashkach metzia, af al gav deraa hi ledideh, dei shama ba malka shakel la minneh, hasheta miha tova hi.
Hayta ishto meubberet veamar: "yehi ratzon shetteled kulei" — hare zo tefillat shav.

Vela mahane rachame? metiv rav yosef: "veachar yalda bat vattikra et shemah dina": may "veachar"? amar rav: leachar sheddana lea din beatzmah veamra: shenem asar shevatim atidin latzet miyyaakov, shishsha yatzu mimmenni vearbaa min hashshefachot, hare asara. im ze zachar, lo tehe achoti rachel keachat hashshefachot, miyyad nehefcha levat, shenneemar: "vattikra et shemah dina". en mazkirin maase nissim.

Veibbaet ema: maase delea betoch arbaim yom hava. kidtanya: shelosha yamim harishonim — yevakkesh adam rachamim shello yasriach. mishshelosha vead arbaim yevakkesh rachamim sheyyehe zachar. mearbaim yom vead shelosha chodashim — yevakkesh rachamim shello yehe sandal. mishshelosha chodashim vead shishsha — yevakkesh rachamim shello yehe nefel. mishshishsha vead tisha — yevakkesh rachamim sheyyetze beshalom.

Umi mahane rachame? vehaamar rav yitzchak bereh derav amme: ish mazria techilla — yoledet nekeva, ishsha mazraat techilla — yoledet zachar. shenneemar: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar"! hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehizriu shenehem bevat achat.
Haya ba badderech.

Tanu rabbanan: maase behillel hazzaken shehaya ba badderech veshama kol tzevacha bair, amar: muvetach ani sheen ze betoch beti. vealav hakkatuv omer: "mishshemua raa lo yira nachon libbo batuach baAdonai". amar rava: kol hechi dedarshat lehay kera meresheh lesefeh — midderish, missefeh leresheh — midderish: meresheh lesefeh midderish — "mishshemua raa lo yira", ma taam? — "nachon libbo batuach baAdonai". missefeh leresheh midderish — "nachon libbo batuach baAdonai, mishshemua raa lo yira".

Hahu talmida dahava ka azel batreh derabbi yishmael berabbi yose beshuka detziyyon. chazyeh deka mefached. amar leh: chattaa at, dichtiv: "pachadu vetziyyon chataim". amar leh: vehachtiv "ashre adam mefached tamid"! amar leh: hahu bedivre tora ketiv.

Yehuda bar natan hava shakel veazel batreh derav hamenuna. ittenach. amar leh: yissurim bae hahu gavra leetuye annafsheh? dichtiv: "ki fachad pachadti vayyeetayeni vaasher yagorti yavo li"! veha ketiv: "ashre adam mefached tamid"! hahu bedivre tora ketiv.
Hannichnas lichrach.

Tanu rabbanan: bichnisato mahu omer? — "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettachniseni lichrach ze leshalom". nichnas, omer: "mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehichnastani lichrach ze leshalom". bikkesh latzet, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay velohe avotay, shettotzieni mikkerach ze leshalom". yatza, omer: "mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehotzetani mikkerach ze leshalom. ucheshem shehotzetani leshalom, kach tolicheni leshalom, vetismecheni leshalom, vetatzideni leshalom, vetatztzileni mikkaf kol oyev veorev badderech".
Amar rav matna: lo shanu ella bichrach sheen danin vehorgin bo, aval bichrach sheddanin vehorgin bo — let lan ba.
Ikka deamri, amar rav matna: afillu bichrach sheddanin vehorgin bo, zimnin dela mitreme leh inash deyalef leh zechuta.

Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas levet hammerchatz, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettatztzileni mizze vechayyotze bo, veal yeera bi devar kalkala veavon. veim yeera bi devar kalkala veavon — tehe mitati kappara lechol avonotay".
Amar abbaye: la lema inash hachi, dela liftach pummeh lesatan. deamar resh lakish, vechen tana mishshemeh derav yose: leolam al yiftach adam piv lassatan.
Amar rav yosef: may keraa — dichtiv: "kimat kisdom hayinu laamora daminu", may ahdar lehu navi — "shimu devar Adonai ketzine sedom vegomer".
Ki nafek may omer? amar rav acha: "mode ani lefanecha Adonai shehitztzaltani min haur".
Rabbi avahu al leve vane. ippechit be vane mittuteh, itrechish leh nissa kam al ammuda, sheziv mea vechad gavre bechad evreh. amar: hayeynu derav acha.

Deamar rav acha: hannichnas lehakkiz dam, omer: "yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay sheyyehe esek ze li lirfua, uterappeeni. ki el rofe neeman atta urefuatcha emet, lefi sheen darkan shel bene adam lerappoot ella shennahagu".
Amar abbaye: la lema inash hachi, detane deve rabbi yishmael: "verappo yerappe" — mikkan shennittena reshut larofe lerappoot.
Ki kae may omer? — amar rav acha: "baruch … rofe chinnam".
b: Hannichnas levet hakkisse, omer: "hitkabbedu mechubbadim kedoshim mesharte elyon, tenu kavod lelohe yisrael, harepu mimmenni ad sheekkanes veeese retzoni veavo alechem". amar abbaye: la lema inash hachi, dilma shavki leh veazli. ella lema: "shimruni shimruni, izruni izruni, simchuni simchuni, hametinu li hametinu li ad sheekkanes veetze, shekken darkan shel bene adam". ki nafek, omer: "baruch ... asher yatzar et haadam bechochma, uvara bo nekavim nekavim, chalalim chalalim, galuy veyadua lifne kisse kevodecha sheim yippateach echad mehem o im yissatem echad mehem i efshar laamod lefanecha".

May chatem? amar rav: "rofe cholim". amar shemuel: ka shavvinhu abba lechulle alma ketzire. ella: "rofe chol basar". rav sheshet amar: "mafli laasot". amar rav pappa: hilkach nemrinhu letarvayyhu — "rofe chol basar umafli laasot".

Hannichnas lishan al mittato, omer mishshema yisrael" ad "vehaya im shamoa", veomer: "baruch … hammappil chavle shena al enay utenuma al afappay, umeir leishon bat ayin. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay, shettashkiveni leshalom, veten chelki betoratecha, vetargileni lide mitzva, veal targileni lide avera, veal tevieni lide chet, velo lide avon, velo lide nissayon, velo lide vizzayon. veyishlot bi yetzer tov, veal yishlot bi yetzer hara. vetatztzileni mippega ra, umecholaim raim. veal yevahaluni chalomot raim vehirhurim raim. utehe mittati shelema lefanecha. vehaer enay pen ishan hammavet. baruch atta Adonai hammeir laolam kullo bichvodo".

Ki mittear omer: "elohay, neshama shennatatta bi tehora. atta yetzartah bi, atta nefachtah bi, veatta meshammerah bekirbi, veatta atid littelah mimmenni ulehachazirah bi leatid lavo. kol zeman shehanneshama bekirbi mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay velohe avotay, ribbon kol haolamim, adon kol hanneshamot. baruch atta Adonai, hammachazir neshamot lifgarim metim".

Ki shama kol tarnegola, lema: "baruch … asher natan lassechvi bina lehavechin ben yom uven layla". ki patach eneh, lema: "baruch … pokeach ivverim". ki taretz veyatev, lema: "baruch … mattir asurim". ki lavesh, lema: "baruch … malbish arummim". ki zakef, lema: "baruch … zokef kefufim". ki nachet leara, lema: "baruch … roka haaretz al hammayim". ki mesagge, lema: "baruch … hammechin mitzade gaver". ki sayyem mesaneh, lema: "baruch … sheasa li kol tzorki". ki asar hemyayneh, lema: "baruch … ozer yisrael bigvura". ki pares sudara al resheh, lema: "baruch … oter yisrael betifara".

Ki miataf betzitzit, lema: "baruch … asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit". ki mannach tefillin adderaeh, lema: "baruch … asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehanniach tefillin", aresheh, lema: "baruch … asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat tefillin". ki mashe yedeh ,lema: "baruch … asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim". ki mashe appeh, lema: baruch … hammaavir chevle shena meenay utenuma meafappay. vihi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay, shettargileni betoratecha, vedabbekeni bemitzvotecha, veal tevieni lo lide chet, velo lide avon, velo lide nissayon, velo lide vizzayon. vechof et yitzri lehishtabed lach. verachakeni meadam ra, umechaver ra. vedabbekeni beyetzer tov uvechaver tov beolamecha. uteneni hayyom uvechol yom lechen ulechesed ulerachamim beenecha uveene kol roay, vetigmeleni chasadim tovim. baruch atta Adonai gomel chasadim tovim leammo yisrael".

Chayyayv adam levarech kulei: may "chayyayv levarech al haraa keshem shemmevarech al hattova"? illema keshem shemmevarech al hattova "hattov vehammetiv", kach mevarech al haraa "hattov vehammetiv", vehatnan al besorot tovot omer "hattov vehammetiv", al besorot raot omer "baruch … dayyayn haemet"! amar rava: lo nitzrecha, ella lekabbolinhu besimcha.
Amar rav acha mishshum rabbi levi: may kera — "chesed umishpat ashira lecha Adonai azammera". im chesed — ashira, veim mishpat — ashira.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar, mehacha: "baAdonai ahallel davar belohim ahallel davar". baAdonai ahallel davar — zo midda tova, belohim ahallel davar — zo middat pureanut.
Rabbi tanchum amar: mehacha: "kos yeshuot essa uveshem Adonai ekra", "tzara veyagon emtza uveshem Adonai ekra".
Verabbanan amri, mehacha: "Adonai natan vaAdonai lakach yehi shem Adonai mevorach".
Amar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir, vechen tana mishshemeh derabbi akiva: leolam yehe adam ragil lomar: "kol deaved rachamana letav aved".

Ki ha derabbi akiva dahava kaazel beorcha. meta lehahi mata, bea ushepiza la yahavi leh. amar: "kol deaved rachamana — letav". azal uvat bedavra, vahava bahadeh tarnegola vachamara usheraga. ata zika kavyeh lishraga. ata shunnara achleh letarnegola. ata arya achleh lachamara. amar: "kol deaved rachamana — letav". beh belelya ata geyaysa, shavyay lemata. amar lehu: lav amari lechu kol ma sheose hakkadosh baruch hu

a: Hakkol letova.

Veamar rav huna amar rav mishshum rabbi meir: leolam yihyu devarav shel adam muatin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "al tevahel al picha velibbecha al yemaher lehotzi davar lifne haelohim ki haelohim bashshamayim veatta al haaretz al ken yihyu devarecha meattim".
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: may dichtiv "vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam" bishne yodin? — shene yetzarim bara hakkadosh baruch hu, echad yetzer tov veechad yetzer ra.

Matkif la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ella meatta, behema dela ketiv ba "vayyitzer" let la yitzra? veha ka chazenan demazzeka venashcha uvaata! ella kidrabbi shimon ben pazzi, deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi "oy li miyyotzri veoy li miyyitzri".
I name kidrabbi yirmeya ben elazar. deamar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: du partzufin bara hakkadosh baruch hu baadam harishon, shenneemar: "achor vakedem tzartani".
"Vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela".
Rav ushemuel: chad amar partzuf. vechad amar zanav.

Bishlama leman deamar partzuf — hayeynu dichtiv "achor vakedem tzartani". ella leman deamar zanav, may "achor vakedem tzartani"? kidrabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: "achor" — lemaase vereshit, "vakedem" — lefureanut.

Bishlama "achor" lemaase vereshit — dela ibberi ad maale shabbeta, ella "vakedem" lefureanut, pureanut demay? illema pureanut denachash, vehatanya rabbi omer: bigdulla matchilin min haggadol, uviklala matchilin min hakkatan.

Bigdulla matchilin min haggadol — dichtiv: "vaydabber moshe el aharon veel elazar veel itamar banav hannotarim kechu vegomer". biklala matchilin min hakkatan — battechilla nitkallel nachash, ulevassof nitkallela chavva, ulevassof nitkallel adam!
Ella pureanut demabbul, dichtiv: "vayyimach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama meadam vead behema", beresha adam vahadar behema.
Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv "vayyitzer" bishne yodin. ella leman deamar zanav, may "vayyitzer"?
Kidrabbi shimon ben pazzi, deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi: "oy li miyyotzri oy li miyyitzri".

Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv "zachar unekeva beraam", ella leman deamar zanav, may "zachar unekeva beraam"? kidrabbi avahu, derabbi avahu rame: ketiv: "zachar unekeva beraam", uchetiv "ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam"! ha ketzad? — battechilla ala bemachshava livrot shenayim, ulevassof lo nivra ella echad.

Bishlama leman deamar partzuf, hayeynu dichtiv "vayyisgor basar tachtenna", ella leman deamar zanav, may "vayyisgor basar tachtenna"? amar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rav zevid, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo nitzrecha ella limkom chatach.
Bishlama leman deamar zanav, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyiven", ella leman deamar partzuf, may "vayyiven"?

Lechidrabbi shimon ben menasya. dedaresh rabbi shimon ben menasya: may dichtiv "vayyiven Adonai et hatztzela"? melammed shekkilleah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva, veheviah leadam harishon — shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita "bannayyta".

Davar acher: "vayyiven", amar rav chisda, veamri la bematnita tana: melammed shebbenaah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva kevinyan otzar, ma otzar ze katzar millemala verachav millematta kede lekabbel et happerot, af ishsha ketzara millemala urechava millematta kede lekabbel et havvalad.

"Vayvieha el haadam", amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar: melammed shennaasa hakkadosh baruch hu shoshvin leadam harishon, mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz sheyyachazor gadol im katan beshoshvinut, veal yera lo.

Uleman deamar "partzuf", he minnayyhu saggi beresha? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mistabbera degavra saggi beresha. detanya: lo yehallech adam achore ishsha badderech, vaafillu ishto. nizdammena lo al haggesher — yesallekenna litzdadin. vechol haover achore ishsha bannahar — en lo chelek leolam habba.

Tanu rabbanan: hammartze maot leishsha miyyado leyadah kede lehistakkel bah, afillu yesh beyado tora umaasim tovim kemoshe rabbenu — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam. shenneemar "yad leyad lo yinnake ra" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.
Amar rav nachman: manoach am haaretz haya, dichtiv: "vayyelech manoach achare ishto".

Matkif la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ella meatta, gabbe elkana, dichtiv: "vayyelech elkana achare ishto", vegabbe elisha, dichtiv: "vayyakom vayyelech achareha", hachi name achareha mammash? ella achare devareha veachare atzatah, hacha name achare devareha veachare atzatah.

Amar rav ashe: ulemay dekaamar rav nachman, manoach am haaretz haya — afillu be rav name la kera, shenneemar: "vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim vattelachna achare haish" — velo lifne haish.
Amar rabbi yochanan: achore ari velo achore ishsha, achore ishsha velo achore avoda zara, achore avoda zara velo achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin.

Vela amaran ella dela dare midde, vei dare midde — let lan ba. vela amaran ella delekka pitcha acharina, vei ikka pitcha acharina — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela rechiv chamara, aval rechiv chamara — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela mannach tefillin, aval mannach tefillin — let lan ba.

Amar rav: yetzer hara dome lizvuv veyoshev ben shene mifteche hallev, shenneemar: "zevuve mavet yavish yabbia shemen rokeach". ushemuel amar: kemin chitta hu dome, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz".
Tanu rabbanan: shete kelayot yesh bo beadam, achat yoatzto letova veachat yoatzto leraa. umistabbera detova limino veraa lismolo, dichtiv: "lev chacham limino velev kesil lismolo".
Tanu rabbanan: kelayot yoatzot, lev mevin, lashon mechattech, pe gomer, veshet machnis umotzi kol mine maachol, kane motzi kol,
b: Rea shoevet kol mine mashkin, kaved koes, mara zoreket bo tippa umenichato, techol sochek, kurkevan tochen, keva yeshena, af neor. neor hayyashen yashen hanneor — nimmok veholech lo. tana: im shenehem yeshenim o shenehem neorim — miyyad met.

Tanya rabbi yose haggelili omer: tzaddikim yetzer tov shoftan, shenneemar: "velibbi chalal bekirbi". reshaim yetzer ra shoftan, shenneemar: "neum pesha larasha bekerev libbi en pachad elohim leneged enav". benonim — ze vaze shoftan, shenneemar: "yaamod limin evyon lehoshia mishshofte nafsho".
Amar rabba: kegon anu benonim. amar leh abbaye: la shavek mar chayye lechol beriyya?

Veamar rava: la ibberi alma ella lerashshie gemure o letzaddike gemure. amar rava: lidda inash benafsheh im tzaddik gamur hu im lav. amar rav: la ibberi alma ella leachav ben amri ulerabbi chanina ben dosa. leachav ben amri — haolam hazze, ulerabbi chanina ben dosa — haolam habba.

"Veahavta et Adonai elohecha". tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: im neemar "bechol nafshecha", lamma neemar "bechol meodecha"?, veim neemar "bechol meodecha", lamma neemar "bechol nafshecha"? ella im yesh lecha adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono — lechach neemar "bechol nafshecha". veim yesh lach adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo — lechach neemar "bechol meodecha". rabbi akiva omer: "bechol nafshecha" afillu notel et nafshecha.

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat gazra malchut harshaa shello yaasku yisrael battora. ba pappus ben yehuda umetzao lerabbi akiva shehaya makhil kehillot barabbim veosek battora. amar lo: akiva i atta mityare mippene malchut?

Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome — leshual shehaya mehallech al gav hannahar, veraa dagim shehayu mitkabbetzim mimmakom lemakom. amar lahem: mippene ma attem borchim? amru lo: mippene reshatot shemmeviin alenu bene adam. amar lahem: retzonchem shettaalu layyabbasha, venadur ani veattem, keshem sheddaru avotay im avotechem? amru lo: atta hu sheomrim alecha pikkeach shebbachayyot?! lo pikkeach atta, ella tippesh atta! uma bimkom chiyyutenu, anu mityarin, bimkom mitatenu — al achat kamma vechamma. af anachnu achshav sheanu yoshvim veoskim battora, shekkatuv bah: "ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha", kach, im anu holchim umevattelim mimmenna — al achat kamma vechamma!

Amru: lo hayu yamim muatim, ad shettefasuhu lerabbi akiva vachavashuhu bevet haasurim, vetafsu lefappus ben yehuda vachavashuhu etzlo. amar lo: pappus, mi haviacha lechan? amar lo: ashrecha rabbi akiva shennitpasta al divre tora. oy lo lefappus shennitpas al devarim betelim.

Beshaa shehotziu et rabbi akiva lahariga zeman keriat shema haya, vehayu sorkim et besaro bemasrekot shel barzel, vehaya mekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim. amru lo talmidav: rabbenu, ad kan?! amar lahem: kol yamay hayiti mitztaer al pasuk ze "bechol nafshecha" afillu notel et nishmatcha. amarti: matay yavo leyadi vaakayyeymennu, veachshav shebba leyadi, lo akayyeymennu? haya maarich beechad", ad sheyyatzta nishmato beechad". yatzta bat kol veamra: "ashrecha rabbi akiva sheyyatza nishmatcha beechad".

Amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: zo tora vezo secharah? "mimtim yadcha Adonai mimtim vegomer"! amar lahem: "chelkam bachayyim". yatzta bat kol veamra: "ashrecha rabbi akiva sheatta mezumman lechayye haolam habba".

Lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo amru ella min hatztzofim velifnim, uveroe. ittemar name: amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: lo amru ella min hatztzofim velifnim, uveroe uvesheen gader, uvizman shehashshechina shora.

Tanu rabbanan: hannifne bihuda, lo yippane mizrach umaarav, ella tzafon vedarom. uvaggalil lo yippane ella mizrach umaarav. verabbi yose mattir. shehaya rabbi yose omer: lo asru ella beroe, uvemakom sheen sham gader, uvizman shehashshechina shora. vachachamim osrim.
Chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu tzedadin.

Tanya iddach: hannifne bihuda — lo yippane mizrach umaarav ella tzafon vedarom. uvaggalil, tzafon vedarom — asur, mizrach umaarav — muttar. verabbi yose mattir. shehaya rabbi yose omer: lo asru ella beroe. rabbi yehuda omer: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym — asur, bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym — muttar. rabbi akiva oser bechol makom.
Rabbi akiva hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu chutz laaretz.
Rabba havo shadyayn leh livne mizrach umaarav. azal abbaye shedanhu tzefon vedarom, al rabba tartzanhu. amar: man hay dekamtzaar li? ana kerabbi akiva sevira li deamar: bechol makom asur.
